     [q].[Amount] as 'Settlement Amount'
--    [_].[Personalized__c]
from [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrders] as [_]
LEFT JOIN (

SELECT 
p.[Order__c],
SUM(p.[Amount]) as 'Amount'
FROM (

select [k].[Order__c] as [Order__c],
    case
        when [k].[Type__c] = 'Debit' and [k].[Type__c] is not null
        then [k].[Amount__c]
        else [k].[Amount__c] * -1
    end as [Amount]
from 
(
    select  [k].[Order__c],
        [k].[Amount__c],
        [k].[Type__c]
        from [dr].[PuritanSalesforceSettlement] as [k]
    where (([k].[IsDeleted] = 0 and [k].[IsDeleted] is not null) and ([k].[Settled__c] = 1 and [k].[Settled__c] is not null)) and (([k].[Void__c] = 0 and [k].[Void__c] is not null) and ([k].[Status__c] <> 'Error' or [k].[Status__c] is null))
) as [k]

) as [p]

GROUP BY p.[Order__c]

) as [q] ON
[_].[Id] = [q].[Order__c]
where [_].[IsDeleted] = 0 and [_].[IsDeleted] is not null and [_].[Order_Status__c] <> 'Cancelled'',

properties.description: Update flags in dr.calendar table to take care of different calculations like MTD, YTD, WTD, QTD

scripts.text:
DECLARE @today date;
DECLARE @today_last_year date;

DECLARE @current_FY smallint;
DECLARE @last_FY smallint;
DECLARE @current_CY smallint;
DECLARE @last_CY smallint;

DECLARE @current_FQ nvarchar(2);
DECLARE @current_Q tinyint;
DECLARE @current_M tinyint;
DECLARE @current_W tinyint;

SET DATEFIRST 1;

SET @today = DATEADD(day,-1,sysdatetimeoffset() AT TIME ZONE 'Eastern Standard Time')
SET @today_last_year = DATEADD(YEAR,-1,@today); 

SET @current_FY = (SELECT [Fiscal Year] FROM dr.calendar WHERE [Date] = @today);
SET @current_FQ = (SELECT [Fiscal Quarter] FROM dr.calendar WHERE [Date] = @today);
SET @current_Q = (SELECT [Qtr No.] FROM dr.calendar WHERE [Date] = @today);
SET @current_M = (SELECT [Month No.] FROM dr.calendar WHERE [Date] = @today);
SET @current_W = DATENAME(ww,@today);

SET @last_FY = @current_FY - 1;
SET @current_CY = YEAR(@today);
SET @last_CY = @current_CY - 1;

UPDATE dr.calendar
SET 

YTD_FLAG = q.YTD_FLAG
,FYTD_FLAG = q.FYTD_FLAG
,FQTD_FLAG = q.FQTD_FLAG
,QTD_FLAG = q.QTD_FLAG
,MTD_FLAG = q.MTD_FLAG
,DAY_FLAG = q.DAY_FLAG
,IS_MONTH_CLOSED = q.IS_MONTH_CLOSED
,WTD_FLAG = q.WTD_FLAG
,DAY_INCLUDE_WEEKEND_FLAG=q.DAY_INCLUDE_WEEKEND_FLAG
FROM (
SELECT [date_key]
	  , CASE WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @current_FY AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @current_FY THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @last_FY AND [Date] <= @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @last_FY THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'FYTD_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Year] = @current_CY THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND [Date] <= @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'YTD_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @current_FY AND [Fiscal Quarter] = @current_FQ AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @current_FY AND [Fiscal Quarter] = @current_FQ THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @last_FY AND [Fiscal Quarter] = @current_FQ AND [Date] <= @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Fiscal Year] = @last_FY AND [Fiscal Quarter] = @current_FQ THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'FQTD_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND [Qtr No.] = @current_Q AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND [Qtr No.] = @current_Q THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND [Qtr No.] = @current_Q AND [Date] <= @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND [Qtr No.] = @current_Q THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'QTD_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND [Month No.] = @current_M AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND [Month No.] = @current_M THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND [Month No.] = @current_M AND [Date] <= @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND [Month No.] = @current_M THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'MTD_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Date] <= EOMONTH(DATEADD(month,-1,@today)) THEN 'Y'
	  END as 'IS_MONTH_CLOSED'
	  , CASE WHEN [Date] = @today THEN 'TY' 
		WHEN [Date] = @today_last_year THEN 'LY'
	  END as 'DAY_FLAG'
	  , CASE WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND DATENAME(ww,[Date]) = @current_W AND [Date] <= @today THEN 'TY' 
	    WHEN [Year] = @current_CY AND DATENAME(ww,[Date]) = @current_W THEN 'TY-REM'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND DATENAME(ww,DATEADD(ww,52,[Date])) = @current_W AND [Date] <= DATEADD(ww,-52,@today) THEN 'LY'
		WHEN [Year] = @last_CY AND DATENAME(ww,DATEADD(ww,52,[Date])) = @current_W THEN 'LY-REM'
	  END as 'WTD_FLAG',
	  CASE 
	  WHEN [Date] >= DATEADD(d,-2,@today) and [Date] <=@today 
	  and datename(weekday,sysdatetimeoffset() AT TIME ZONE 'Eastern Standard Time')='Monday'
	  THEN 'TY' 
       WHEN [Date] = @today THEN 'TY' 
	  END as 'DAY_INCLUDE_WEEKEND_FLAG'
  FROM [dr].[calendar] ) q
  WHERE [dr].[calendar].date_key = q.date_key;

SELECT
  CASE  WHEN Table__1."/BIC/YAC_GI_DH"='00000000' THEN NULL
ELSE TO_Date(Table__1."/BIC/YAC_GI_DH")
END AS "DH Actual GI Date",

  CASE WHEN LENGTH(Table__80."EANUPC") = 0
THEN
( CASE WHEN LENGTH(Table__29."EANUPC") > 0 AND LENGTH(Table__29."EANUPC") <= 8
THEN LPAD(Table__29."EANUPC",8,'0')
WHEN LENGTH(Table__29."EANUPC") > 8 AND LENGTH(Table__29."EANUPC") <= 12
THEN LPAD(Table__29."EANUPC",12,'0')
ELSE Table__29."EANUPC"
END)
ELSE
(CASE WHEN LENGTH(Table__80."EANUPC") > 0 AND LENGTH(Table__80."EANUPC") <= 8
THEN LPAD(Table__80."EANUPC",8,'0')
WHEN LENGTH(Table__80."EANUPC") > 8 AND LENGTH(Table__80."EANUPC") <= 12
THEN LPAD(Table__80."EANUPC",12,'0')
ELSE Table__80."EANUPC"
END)
END AS "MA EAN/UPC",
  Table__1."DOC_NUMBER" AS "OH Sales Document ID",
  Table__1."DOC_TYPE" AS "OH Sales Doc Type ID",
  Table__14."TXTSH" AS "OH Sales Doc Type",
  Table__1."/BIC/YOH_SALE" AS "OH Sales Org ID",
  Table__105."TXTLG" AS "OH Sales Org",

  Sum(Table__1."/BIC/YCMLQTYM1") AS "OL Ordered Sales UOM Qty",
  SUM((Case when Table__1."SALESORG" = 'US06' and Table__1."DISTR_CHAN" = '07' then
Table__1."/BIC/YOORQTYM" - Table__1."/BIC/YCMLCMQTY"
else 
Table__1."/BIC/YCMLQTYM1" - Table__1."/BIC/YCMLCMQTY"
end) 
+
(Case when Table__1."SALESORG" = 'US06' and Table__1."DISTR_CHAN" = '07' then
Table__1."/BIC/YCMLCMQTY" -Table__1."DLV_QTY"
else
Table__1."/BIC/YCMLCMQTY" - Table__1."/BIC/YDLVQTY_M"

end)) AS "OL Total Short Qty (MD SUOM)",

  Table__1."REASON_REJ" AS "OL Reason for Rejection ID",
  Table__1."/BIC/YCUSGRP15" AS "OH Customer Group 15 ID",
  Table__25."TXTSH" AS "OH Customer Group 15",

Table__1."/BIC/YGTPERNR"

 ELSE To_date(Table__1."/BIC/YBH_DATE")

when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'E' then 'Item Deletion (No longer valid)'
when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'F' then 'POD Time Change'

when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'H' then 'Depart Date'
when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'I' then 'Last Receiving Date at Port'

when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'K' then 'Reason for Rejection (NNF)'

when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'M' then 'Material Change'
when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'N' then 'Shipping Condition Change'
when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'O' then 'Order Qty Change'
when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'P' then 'Plant Change'
WHEN Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'Q' then 'Planned PGI Date'
when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'R' then 'Route Change'
when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'S' then 'Shipping Point Change'
when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'T' then 'Qty Change at POD'
when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'U' then 'RDD header change'
when Table__1."/BIC/YQTYCI2" = 'V' then 'On Time Delivery'

  sum(Table__1."BILL_QTY") AS "BL Billed Base UOM Qty",

  CASE  WHEN Table__1."/BIC/YCRTD_OH" ='00000000' THEN NULL

 END AS "OH Created On",

  CASE WHEN Table__1."/BIC/YBH_DATE"='00000000' THEN NULL

  CASE WHEN ( CASE  WHEN Table__1."/BIC/YAC_GI_DH"='00000000' THEN NULL

activities.name: IntegratedOrders_SCDType2
activities.description: This script will check all active records and will disable them if there is a newer record available. This way we can have history of how the records are changing over time but will only have the latest as active.

scripts.text:
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#F_Table_Dates') IS NOT NULL
DROP TABLE #F_Table_Dates 

select * 

into #F_Table_Dates

from (
		 select 
				 OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID
				,OrderLINeItemNumber
				,Start_Date
				,End_Date
				,lead(Start_Date,1) over (
											partition by OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID,OrderLINeItemNumber order by convert(date,Start_Date)) as next_start 

		FROM
				[dr].[IntegratedOrders]

				) sub where next_start is not null AND End_Date <> dateadd(second,-1,next_start) AND convert(date,End_Date) = convert(date,'9999-12-31')


IF EXISTS (
	SELECT 1
	FROM #F_Table_Dates b 
)
			BEGIN
				
				UPDATE [dr].[IntegratedOrders]
				set End_Date = dateadd(second,-1,b.next_start)
				from #F_Table_Dates b
				where	b.OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID = [IntegratedOrders].OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID AND
						b.OrderLINeItemNumber =[IntegratedOrders].OrderLINeItemNumber
						
					and [IntegratedOrders].Start_Date = b.Start_Date
					and b.End_Date <> dateadd(second,-1,b.next_start)
					and convert(date,b.End_Date) = convert(date,'9999-12-31')
					AND CONVERT(DATE,[IntegratedOrders].End_Date) = convert(date,'9999-12-31')

			END

WITH MultipleLoads AS (
						SELECT  
								 [SS].[CREATION_TIME]
								,[SS].[CALDAY]
								,RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY [SS].[CALDAY] ORDER BY [SS].[CREATION_TIME] DESC) AS RN
						FROM 
									[dr].[NHSC_SalesSummary] SS
						JOIN		[dr].[calendar] C on [C].[Date]=[SS].[CALDAY]
						LEFT JOIN	[dr].[NHSC_SalesSummaryDatesExceptions] E on [E].[Date]=c.[Date]
						WHERE case when first_day_in_cal_month_ind='Y' or last_day_in_cal_month_ind='Y' or [E].[Date] is not null  then 1 else 0 End = 0
						GROUP BY 
								 [SS].[CREATION_TIME]
								,[SS].[CALDAY]
						)

DELETE 
		SS
FROM
		[dr].[NHSC_SalesSummary] SS

JOIN 
		MultipleLoads M ON  [M].[CALDAY]=[SS].[CALDAY] AND [M].[CREATION_TIME]=[SS].[CREATION_TIME]
WHERE 
		M.RN>1

declare @monthrange_end date = '@{if(empty(pipeline().parameters.end_date),formatDateTime(utcnow(),'yyyy-MM-dd'),pipeline().parameters.end_date)}'

begin
set @begindate=DATEADD(month,@cw,@currentdate)
set @enddate= case when @cw+@monthsinbatch-1 >= @totalmonths then DATEADD(month,@totalmonths-1,@currentdate) else  DATEADD(month,@cw+@monthsinbatch-1,@currentdate) end

set @monthfilter +=  CONCAT(',''' ,format(DATEADD(day, -DAY(@begindate)+1,@begindate),'yyyy-MM-dd')
                                 ,''':'''
                                 ,format(EOMONTH(@enddate),'yyyy-MM-dd'),'''')
set @cw = @cw+@monthsinbatch
end

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT DISTINCT
        [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure AS MainReasonCode
        ,(CASE
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'CC' THEN 'CD: Credit/Cash'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'CM' THEN 'CD: Customer Misalignment'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'CO' THEN 'CD: Customer Operations'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'CP' THEN 'Corporate'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'CR' THEN 'CD: Customer Request'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'CU' THEN 'CUSTOMER'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'DD' THEN 'DIRECT DELIVERY DRAG REASONS'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'DL' THEN 'SD: Delivery'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'DM' THEN 'SD: Demand Planning issues'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'DP' THEN 'DISPUTE MANAGEMENT'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'FM' THEN 'SD: External factors'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'NS' THEN 'SD: Not specified'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'OM' THEN 'ORDER MANAGEMENT'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'PL' THEN 'SD: Planning'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'PR' THEN 'SD: Production'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'QI' THEN 'QUALITY'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'SD' THEN 'Sales - Damages In Cust. Store (NF)'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'SL' THEN 'SALES'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'SP' THEN 'SD: Supply Planning'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'ST' THEN 'STOCK'
                WHEN [rc].CustomerServiceMainReasonCodeForFailure = 'WH' THEN 'WAREHOUSE'
                ELSE ''
        END) AS MainReasonCodeDescription         
        ,[src].[CustomerServiceSubReasonCodeForFailure] AS SubReasonCode
        ,[src].[CustomerServiceReasonCodeDescription] AS SubReasonCodeDescription
        ,[ReasonCodeAtOrderChange] "ReasonCodeAtOrderChange"
        ,[ReasonCodeForConfirmedQtyAtOrderStage] "ReasonCodeForConfirmedQtyAtOrderStage"
        ,[ReasonCodeAtDeliveryStage] "ReasonCodeAtDeliveryStage"
        ,[ReasonCodeAtPODStage] "ReasonCodeAtProofOfDeliveryStage"
        ,[OrderReason] "OrderReason"
        ,[ReasonForRejection] "ReasonForRejection"
        ,[ReasonCodeOfNestleFailure] "ReasonCodeOfNestleFailure"
        ,[ReasonCodeOfDirectDeliveries] "ReasonCodeOfDirectDeliveries"
        ,[ReasonCodeShowedInDMC] "DemandManagementCockpitReasonCode"
        ,[NonDDDate/TimeChange] "NonDirectDeliveryDateORTimeChange"
        ,[ReasonCodeForLatePGI] "LatePostGoodsIssueReasonCode"
        ,[FlagForUn-availableProduct] "FlagForUnavailableProduct"
        ,[IndicatorToCheckIfTheReasonCodeIsValidForOSA] "OnShelfAvailablityValidIndicator"
        ,[OOSRepository] "OutOfStockIndicator"
        ,[CustomerServiceReasonCodeDefinition2] "CustomerServiceNestleFailureIndicator"
        ,[LTTRelevent] "LTTRelevent"
        ,[OTDIndicator] "OnTimeDeliveryIndicator"
        ,[OTDPODIndicator] "OnTimeDeliveryProofOfDeliveryIndicator"
        ,[OTDCustomerPickUpIndicator] "OnTimeDeliveryCustomerPickUpIndicator"
        ,[OTDGoodsReceiptIndicator] "OnTimeDeliveryGoodsReceiptIndicator"
    FROM 
        [RPT_MONO_BV].[V_CustomerServiceSubReasonCodeDescription] [src]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN 
        [RPT_MONO_BV].[V_CustomerServiceReasonCodeDefinition] [rc] ON [src].CustomerServiceSubReasonCodeForFailure = [rc].CustomerServiceSubReasonCodeForFailure     WHERE 
        [LanguageKey] = 'E'

IF DAY(getdate())='1' 
BEGIN
delete dr.DemandPlanningCompLagData
where VersionMonth=cast(year(getdate()) as varchar)+right('00'+cast(month(getdate()) as varchar),2);

insert into dr.DemandPlanningCompLagData
select N9.BomComponent, 
N1.CustomerLevel4,
N1.DistributionChannel,N1.SalesOrganization,
cast(year(getdate()) as varchar)+right('00'+cast(month(getdate()) as varchar),2) VersionMonth,
cast(getdate() as date) LoadDate,
N1.CalendarMonth,
N1.UNIT Unit,
round(sum(cast(N1.FinalCDPQuantity as float))*N9.ComponentQuantity,0) FinalCDPQuantity,
N1.Plant [Location]
from dr.DemandPlanningReport N1 
INNER JOIN dr.NHSc_BOM_Link N3
ON (N1.Material=N3.MaterialNumber
and N1.Plant=N3.Plant) INNER JOIN dr.NHSc_BOM_Item N9
ON (N3.BillOfMaterial=N9.BillOfMaterial
)
INNER join
dr.DimMaterialMaster N2
on (N9.BomComponent=N2.MaterialID)
left outer join (select CustomerLevel4RegionID,CustomerLevel4RegionDescription
from dr.DimCustomerMaster
group by CustomerLevel4RegionID,CustomerLevel4RegionDescription) N4
ON (N1.CustomerHierarchyLevel4=N4.CustomerLevel4RegionID)
left outer join dr.MaterialBasePriceByMonth N5
ON (N1.SalesOrganization+'-'+N1.DistributionChannel+'-'
+N9.BomComponent+'-'+
N1.CalendarMonth=N5.MaterialCalendarMonthKey)
where cast(N1.CalendarMonth+'01' as date) >='2023-03-01'
and N1.MaterialGroup1='75A'
and N2.MaterialType='FERT'
and N9.Is_Deleted='N'
and N3.Is_Deleted='N'
and N3.BillOfMaterial+'-'+N3.AlternativeBOM in
(select NBH.BillOfMaterial+'-'+NBH.AlternativeBOM from dr.NHSC_BOM_Header NBH
where (NBH.DeletionIndicator<>'X' and 
NBH.DeletionFlagForBOMs <> 'X' and NBH.BOMStatus<>'02'))
group by 
N1.CustomerLevel4,
N1.SalesOrganization,	N1.DistributionChannel,N1.CalendarMonth,
N9.BomComponent
,N9.ComponentQuantity,N1.Plant,N1.UNIT ;
END;

round(sum(N1.NetDispatches),0) NetDispatches	,

round(sum(N1.BaseDemandForecast),0) BaseDemandForecast,

round(sum(N1.Impactors)*N5.MaterialBasePrice,2) Impactors_$	,

round(sum(N1.OtherIncrements)*N5.MaterialBasePrice,2) OthIncrements_$	,

dateadd(month,0,cast(N1.VersionMonth+'01' as date))

CalendarMonth,MaterialNumber,CustomerLevel4)

set [MFR-1]=N2.MFRAgreedCDPQuantity1,
[MFR-1_$]=N2.MFRAgreedCDPAmount1

LEFT OUTER JOIN MFR1 AS N2 ON 
(N1.SalesOrganization=N2.SalesOrganization

N1.Material=N2.Material AND N1.CL4_regionID=N2.CustomerLevel4)
where N1.Oracle_Item='CHILD'
and  cast(N1.CalendarMonth+'01' as date)>=
cast(cast(year(getdate()-2) as varchar)+

CalendarMonth,Material,CustomerLevel4,
MFRAgreedCDPQuantity2,
 MFRAgreedCDPAmount2) AS

right('00'+cast(month(getdate()-2) as varchar),2)+'01' as date)=

CalendarMonth,MaterialNumber,CustomerLevel4
)

(N1.SalesOrganization=N2.SalesOrganization

IF OBJECT_ID('dr.MaterialBasePriceByMonth','U') IS NOT NULL  

BEGIN

truncate table dr.MaterialBasePriceByMonth ;

drop table dr.MaterialBasePriceByMonth ;

END;


select SalesOrganization+'-'+
DistributionChannel+'-'+MaterialNumber+'-'+
cast(N2.[Year Month No.] as varchar) MaterialCalendarMonthKey,
[Rate(conditionAmountOrPercentage)WhereNoScaleExists] MaterialBasePrice,
row_number() over (partition by SalesOrganization+'-'+
DistributionChannel+'-'+MaterialNumber+'-'+
cast(N2.[Year Month No.] as varchar) order by 
N1.ValidityStartDateOfTheConditionRecord desc) PriorityLevel
into dr.MaterialBasePriceByMonth
from dr.MaterialBasePrice N1,dr.Calendar N2
where N1.SalesOrganization in ('US8O','US8R')
and N2.[Date]>='2023-03-01'
and N2.[Date]<=getdate()+730
and N2.[Date] between 
N1.ValidityStartDateOfTheConditionRecord and
N1.ValidityEndDateOfTheConditionRecord
group by SalesOrganization+'-'+
DistributionChannel+'-'+MaterialNumber+'-'+
cast(N2.[Year Month No.] as varchar),[Rate(conditionAmountOrPercentage)WhereNoScaleExists],N1.ValidityStartDateOfTheConditionRecord

delete dr.MaterialBasePriceByMonth where PriorityLevel <> 1;

delete from dr.MaterialBasePriceByMonth
where  MaterialCalendarMonthKey in
(
select distinct SalesOrganization+'-'+DistributionChannel+'-'+
MaterialNumber+'-'+substring(N2.MaterialCalendarMonthKey,28,34) 
MaterialKey
from dr.NHSC_SalesDataForMaterial N1,
 dr.MaterialBasePriceByMonth N2
where N1.PricingReferenceMaterial is not null
and N1.SalesOrganization like 'US8%'
and N1.SalesOrganization+'-'+N1.DistributionChannel+'-'+
N1.PricingReferenceMaterial=substring(N2.MaterialCalendarMonthKey,1,26));

insert into dr.MaterialBasePriceByMonth
select distinct SalesOrganization+'-'+DistributionChannel+'-'+
MaterialNumber+'-'+substring(N2.MaterialCalendarMonthKey,28,34) 
MaterialKey,N2.MaterialBasePrice,N2.PriorityLevel
from dr.NHSC_SalesDataForMaterial N1,
 dr.MaterialBasePriceByMonth N2
where N1.PricingReferenceMaterial is not null
and N1.SalesOrganization like 'US8%'
and N1.SalesOrganization+'-'+N1.DistributionChannel+'-'+
N1.PricingReferenceMaterial=substring(N2.MaterialCalendarMonthKey,1,26);

insert into dr.DimMaterialMarketCountry select distinct '172' Client, N3.BOMComponent,N5.CountryKey,N5.CountryName ,
cast(getdate() as varchar) LoadDate
from dr.DimMaterialMaster N1,
dr.NHSc_BOM_Item N3, dr.NHSc_BOM_Link N4 ,dr.DimMaterialMarketCountry N5 where
 N1.MaterialID=N3.BOMComponent
and N4.BillOfMaterial=N3.BillOfMaterial
and N4.MaterialNumber=N5.MaterialNumber
and not exists
(select 'X' from dr.DimMaterialMarketCountry N6 where
ISNULL(N6.CountryKey,'NA')=ISNULL(N5.CountryKey,'NA')
and N6.MaterialNumber=N3.BOMComponent
)
and N5.CountryKey is not null;

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT 
[Client] AS Client,
       CASE
            WHEN [DB_KEY] IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('0x', CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [DB_KEY], 2))
       END AS [DBKey],
       CASE
            WHEN [PARENT_KEY] IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('0x', CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [PARENT_KEY], 2))
       END AS ParentKey,
       CASE
            WHEN [Node] IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('0x', CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [Node], 2))
       END AS Node,
       CASE
            WHEN [CH_INSTANCE_KEY] IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('0x', CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [CH_INSTANCE_KEY], 2))
       END AS ChangeInstanceKey,
       [ChangeCategory] AS ChangeCategory,
       [ChangeType] AS ChangeType,
       [ChangeDescription] AS ChangeDescription,
       [ChangeDocuments:OldValue(valOrVal+unit/currOrString)] AS OldValue,
       [ChangeDocuments:NewValue(valOrVal+unit/currOrString)] AS NewValue,
       [UserNameOfThePersonResponsibleInChangeDocument] AS UserName,
       [UserCategory] AS UserCategory,
       [CreationDateOfTheChangeDocument] AS CreationDate,
       [TimeChanged] AS TimeChanged,
       [TransactionInWhichAChangeWasMade] AS TransactionCode,
       [Indicator:ReasonCodeRequired] AS ReasonCodeIndicator,
       [ReasonCode] AS ReasonCode,
       [FieldName] AS FieldName,
       [DummyFunctionInLength1] AS ChangeLogNodeExtension,
       [IS_DELETED] AS IsDeleted,
       [LAST_TIMESTAMP] AS LastTimeStamp,
       [SLT_LAST_TIMESTAMP] AS SLTLastTimeStamp
  FROM [RPT_TM_BV].[V_EnhancedChangeLogForTOR] a
WITH(NOLOCK)
 WHERE a.LAST_TIMESTAMP >= @{variables('LastUpdate')} and a.LAST_TIMESTAMP <= @{variables('Current_TimeStamp')}

       [TextID] AS TextID,
       [LanguageKey] AS LanguageKey,
       [DunningDate(UsedInRetail)] AS DunningDate,
       [DunningTime(UsedInRetail)] AS DunningTime,
       [AddressType(1=Organization,2=Person,3=ContactPerson)] AS AddressType,
       [RequestedStatus] AS RequestedStatus,
       [MessageDeterminedViaConditions] AS MessageDeterminedViaConditions,
       [ErrorManagementNumber] AS ErrorManagementNumber,
       [Event] AS Event,
       [ObjectType] AS ObjectType,
       [SendTimeRequest] AS SendTimeRequest,
       [CountryKey] AS CountryKey,
       a.[IS_DELETED] AS IsDeleted,
       a.[LAST_TIMESTAMP] AS LastTimeStamp,
       a.[SLT_LAST_TIMESTAMP] AS SLTLastTimeStamp,
       b.SalesDocumentCreatedOn AS SDCreatedon,
       b.SalesOrganization as SalesOrganization
FROM [RPT_MONO_BV].[V_MessageStatus] AS a
 INNER JOIN [RPT_MONO_BV].[V_SalesDocumentHeaderData] AS b
         ON a.ObjectKey = b.SalesDocument
 Where b.SalesOrganization IN ('US01', 'US02', 'US03', 'US04', 'US05', 'US06', 'US07', 'US08','US8R','US8O')
AND a.LAST_TIMESTAMP >= @{variables('LastUpdate')} and a.LAST_TIMESTAMP <= @{variables('Current_TimeStamp')}

IF OBJECT_ID('dr.NHScOspreyTIMConsolidatedForecast','U') IS NOT NULL  
BEGIN

truncate table dr.NHScOspreyTIMConsolidatedForecast;

drop table dr.NHScOspreyTIMConsolidatedForecast;

END;


select 'Osprey' SourceSystem,
'US16' CompanyCode,
N5.[Date] [SalesDate],
cast(N2.[ProductCode] as bigint) [MaterialKey],
replace(N4.CL6Code,'CL6CL5','') [CustomerLevel6PlanningAccountID],
sum(case when ScenarioCode='LE' then round((GPS/cast(day(EOMONTH(N5.[Date])) as int)),5)
else 0 
end) GPSLE,
sum(case when ScenarioCode='LE_CONS' then round((GPS/cast(day(EOMONTH(N5.[Date])) as int)),5)
else 0 
end) GPSConsumptionLE,
sum(case when ScenarioCode='FORECAST' then round((GPS/cast(day(EOMONTH(N5.[Date])) as int)),5)
else 0 
end) GPSForecast,
cast(0 as float) LockedForecast,
sum(case when ScenarioCode='FORECAST' then round((N1.TotalVolume/cast(day(EOMONTH(N5.[Date])) as int)),3)
else 0 
end) DVOVolume,
sum(case when ScenarioCode='LE_CONS' then round((N1.TotalVolume/cast(day(EOMONTH(N5.[Date])) as int)),3)
else 0 
end) DIVOVolume into dr.NHScOspreyTIMConsolidatedForecast
from dr.OspreyTotalSalesMonth N1,
dr.DimOspreyProduct N2,dr.DimOspreyTime N3, dr.DimOspreyCustomer N4,
dr.calendar N5
where N1.ProductId=N2.ProductID
and N1.TimeID=N3.TimeID
and N1.CustomerID=N4.CustomerID
and Year(N5.[Date])=Year(N3.[Day])
and Month(N5.[Date])=Month(N3.[Day])
and N2.SalesOrgCode <> 'NUSA' 
and N2.PL1Code <> 'CA'
and N2.CorporateBrand in ('NESTLE HEALTH SCIENCE','NUUN','CELLTRIENT','CARNATION -- NHS',
'VITAL PROTEINS','FIBER CHOICE','GARD','REMFRESH')
group by N5.[Date],N2.[ProductCode],replace(N4.CL6Code,'CL6CL5','')

select 'Osprey' SourceSystem,
'US16' CompanyCode,
N5.[Date] [SalesDate],
cast(N2.[ProductCode] as bigint) [MaterialKey],
replace(N4.CL6Code,'CL6CL5','') [CustomerLevel6PlanningAccountID],
cast(0 as float) GPSLE,
cast(0 as float) GPSConsumptionLE,
cast(0 as float) GPSForecast,
sum(case when ScenarioCode='FORECAST' then round((GPS/cast(day(EOMONTH(N5.[Date])) as int)),5)
else 0 
end) GPSLockedForecast,
cast(0 as float) DVOVolume,
cast(0 as float) DIVOVolume from dr.OspreyTotalSalesMonthSnapshot N1,
dr.DimOspreyProduct N2,dr.DimOspreyTime N3, dr.DimOspreyCustomer N4,
dr.calendar N5
where N1.ProductId=N2.ProductID
and N1.TimeID=N3.TimeID
and N1.CustomerID=N4.CustomerID
and Year(N5.[Date])=Year(N3.[Day])
and Month(N5.[Date])=Month(N3.[Day])
and N2.SalesOrgCode <> 'NUSA' 
and N2.PL1Code <> 'CA'
and N2.CorporateBrand in ('NESTLE HEALTH SCIENCE','NUUN','CELLTRIENT','CARNATION -- NHS',
'VITAL PROTEINS','FIBER CHOICE','GARD','REMFRESH')
and N1.GPS <> 0
and ScenarioCode='FORECAST'
group by N5.[Date],N2.[ProductCode],replace(N4.CL6Code,'CL6CL5','')
union all
select 'Osprey' SourceSystem,

from dr.OspreyTotalSalesMonth N1,

where N1.ProductId=N2.ProductID

insert into dr.NHScOspreyTIMConsolidatedForecast

'US16' CompanyCode,
N5.[Date] [SalesDate],
cast(N2.[ProductCode] as bigint) [MaterialKey],
replace(N4.CL6Code,'CL6CL5','') [CustomerLevel6PlanningAccountID],

declare @DateValue date
declare @YrMnToConsider char(6)
declare @today datetime = getdate()

--check if today is Last-Day-Of-Month 
if month(@today) <> month(@today+1) 
begin
	set @YrMnToConsider = cast(year(@today) as varchar) + case when month(@today) <= 9 then '0' + cast(month(@today) as varchar) else cast(month(@today) as varchar) end
end
else
begin
	set @YrMnToConsider = left(convert(varchar,dateadd(dd,-1,cast(left(convert(varchar,@today,112),6) + '01' as date)),112),6)
end


set @DateValue = @YrMnToConsider + '01'

select 'NG'+CONVERT(varchar,YEAR(@DateValue)) "Year", FORMAT(MONTH(@DateValue),'000') "Month"

declare @monthrange_begin date = '@{pipeline().parameters.start_date}'
declare @monthrange_end date = '@{if(empty(pipeline().parameters.end_date),formatDateTime(utcnow(),'yyyy-MM-dd'),pipeline().parameters.end_date)}'

SELECT
	  concat('NG',[Year]) "Year",FORMAT([Month No.],'000') "Month"
  FROM [dr].[calendar]
  where [date] between @monthrange_begin and @monthrange_end
  GROUP BY concat('NG',[Year]),FORMAT([Month No.],'000')
  ORDER BY [Year],[Month]

SORDER.[SoldToName1] as 'Sold_To_Name',
REPLACE(LTRIM(REPLACE(SORDER.[CustomerNumberShipTo], '0', ' ')),' ', '0') as 'Ship_To',
SORDER.[ShipToName1] as 'Ship_To_Name',
SORDER.[ShipToHouseNumber] as 'Street_No',
SORDER.[ShipToStreet] as 'Street_Name',
SORDER.[ShipToCity] as 'City',
SORDER.[ShipToRegionOrState] as 'Province',
SORDER.[ShipToPostalCode] as 'Postal_Code',
SORDER.[ShipToCountry] as 'Country',
SORDER.[NetValueOfTheSalesOrderInDocumentCurrency] as 'NPS',
SORDER.[Plant] as 'Ship_From',
SORDER.[PlantName] as 'Ship_From_Name',
SORDER.[VendorNumber] as 'Vendor_Number',
SORDER.[VendorName1] as 'Vendor_Name',
SORDER.[StandardCarrierAccessCode] as 'Standard_Carrier_Access_Code',
INVOICE.[NetValueOfTheBillingItemInDocumentCurrency] as 'ItemNetValue',
SORDER.[ReasonForRejectionOfQuotationsAndSalesOrders] as 'ItemRejectionReason'

FROM dr.OTR_OrderData AS SORDER 
JOIN dr.OTR_InvoiceData AS INVOICE ON SORDER.[SalesDocument] = INVOICE.[SalesDocument] AND SORDER.[SalesDocumentItemNumber] = INVOICE.[SalesDocumentItemNumber]
JOIN dr.OTR_DeliveryData AS DELIVERY ON SORDER.[SalesDocument] = DELIVERY.[SalesDocument] AND SORDER.[SalesDocumentItemNumber] = DELIVERY.[SalesDocumentItemNumber]	
WHERE SORDER.SalesOrganization IN ('US8R','US8O','US01')
AND  ( SORDER.[Plant] LIKE 'UM%' OR SORDER.[Plant] = '5019' )
AND INVOICE.[BillingDocument] IS NOT NULL
AND SORDER.SalesDocumentType IN ('ZSAD','ZDON','ZALV','TA')
AND SORDER.[DistributionChannel] <> '14'
AND DELIVERY.[ActualGoodsMovementDate] BETWEEN CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(month,-6,GETDATE())) AND CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT
	c.[Date],
	[date_key],
	FORMAT(dateadd(day, 0,c.[Date]),'yyyyMMdd')  ToDate,
	[year],
	[Month Full] "month",
	case when first_day_in_cal_month_ind='Y' or last_day_in_cal_month_ind='Y' or e.[Date] is not null  then 1 else 0 End Is_Start_End_Month
	from [dr].[calendar] c
	left join [dr].[NHSC_SalesSummaryDatesExceptions] e on e.[Date]=c.[Date]
where 
	c.[Date] > dateadd(day,-@{pipeline().parameters.DaysToLoad},(Select Max([Calday]) DateVal from [dr].[NHSC_SalesSummary]))
	and c.[Date]<= getdate()-1
	and case when first_day_in_cal_month_ind='Y' or last_day_in_cal_month_ind='Y' or e.[Date] is not null  then 1 else 0 End = 1
	and 1=@{pipeline().parameters.RunType}
	order by c.[Date]

select DISTINCT
 ord.SalesDocument as 'SalesDocument'
,ord.[SalesDocumentType] as 'SalesDocumentType'
,ord.[OverallProcessingStatusOfDocument] as 'OrderHeaderStatus'
,ord.[OverallRejectionStatusOfAllDocumentItems] as 'OrderRejectionStatus'
    ,ord.[DeliveryStatus] as 'OrderDeliveryStatus'
      ,ord.[OverallDeliveryStatusForAllItems] 'OrderOverallDeliveryStatus'
      ,ord.[PostingStatusOfBillingDocument] 'OrderInvoicePostingStatus'
	  ,ord.[GeneralIncompletionStatusOfTheHeader] 'OrderHeaderIncompletionStatus'
	  ,inv.BillingDocument 'BillingDocument'
	  ,inv.StatusForTransferToAccounting 'BillingDocumentStatus'
FROM [RPT_CONNECTEDSC].[V_OTR_OrderData] ord WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN [RPT_CONNECTEDSC].[V_OTR_InvoiceData] inv WITH (NOLOCK) ON ord.SalesDocument = inv.SalesDocument AND ord.[SalesDocumentItem(POSNR)] = inv.[SalesDocumentItem(POSNR)]
WHERE ord.RequestedDeliveryDate >= '2022-01-01'
AND ord.SalesOrganization in ('US01','US02','US03','US04','US05','US06','US07','US08', 'US8R','US8O')
AND ord.SalesDocumentType IN ('G2','KN','RE','ZCR','ZCRQ','ZDR','ZDRQ','ZRF','ZRR', 'TA', 'ZSAD', 'ZDON', 'ZALV', 'ZTSA', 'ZOBC','ZIMS' )

insert into dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference
select right('00000000000'+N1.[SAP Material#],18) SAPMaterialNumber,N1.OracleNumber,null from dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N1
where N1.[SAP Material#] is not null
and N1.[Source]='PDH'
and not exists 
(select 'X' from dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference N2 where N1.OracleNumber=N2.TBCOOracleNumber)
and not exists 
(select 'X' from dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference N3 where N1.[SAP Material#]=N3.SAPMaterialNumber)
and N1.[SAP Material#] not in (select N9.[SAP Material#] from dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N9
where N9.[SAP Material#] is not null
group by N9.[SAP Material#] having count(*) > 1);

insert into dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference
select max(N2.MaterialNumber) MaterialNumber,N1.OracleNumber,null from dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N1,
dr.NHSC_V_GeneralMaterialData N2
where  not exists 
(select 'X' from dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference N3 where N1.OracleNumber=N3.TBCOOracleNumber)
and not exists
(select 'X' from dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference N4 where N1.[SAP Material#]=N4.SAPMaterialNumber)
and not exists
(select 'X' from dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference N5 where N2.MaterialNumber=N5.SAPMaterialNumber)
and N2.OldMaterialNumber=ISNULL(N1.[Primary Suffix],N1.[AS400 Trans Primary Suffix])+'-'+N1.[AS400 #]
and N1.OracleNumber not in ('100186904',
'100156865')
and N2.OldMaterialNumber like '%-%'
and N1.[Source]='PDH'
group by N1.OracleNumber;

insert into dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference
select max(N2.MaterialNumber) MaterialNumber,N1.OracleNumber,null from dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N1,
dr.NHSC_V_GeneralMaterialData N2
where  not exists 
(select 'X' from dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference N3 where N1.OracleNumber=N3.TBCOOracleNumber)
and not exists
(select 'X' from dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference N4 where N1.[SAP Material#]=N4.SAPMaterialNumber)
and not exists
(select 'X' from dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference N5 
where N2.MaterialNumber=N5.SAPMaterialNumber)
and N2.OldMaterialNumber=N1.[AS400 #]
and N1.OracleNumber not in ('100186904',
'100156865')
and N2.MaterialType='ROH'
and N1.ICC='Raw Material'
and N1.[Source]='PDH'
group by N1.OracleNumber;


delete N1 from dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference as N1
where exists
(select 'X' from dr.NHSC_V_GeneralMaterialData N2
where N1.SAPMaterialNumber=N2.MaterialNumber
and N2.OldMaterialNumber like '%Old%');

delete N1 from dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference as N1
where N1.SAPMaterialNumber in
(select SAPMaterialNumber from dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference
group by SAPMaterialNumber having count(*) > 1 )
and exists (select 'X' from dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N2
where N2.OracleNumber=N1.TBCOOracleNumber
and N2.[Source]='PDH'
and N2.ICC='Label');

IF OBJECT_ID('dr.PuritanNTFOrders','U') IS NOT NULL

into dr.PuritanNTFOrders

and cast(order_process_date as date) >getdate() -1100
group by SFA_CUST_NUM,ORDER_NUMBER,ORD_SOURCE_CODE

IF OBJECT_ID('dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder','U') IS NOT NULL  

BEGIN

truncate table dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder ;

drop table dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder ;

END;

select (CASE WHEN Sales_Channel__c='eBay' THEN 'T'
WHEN Sales_Channel__c='Amazon' THEN 'S'
WHEN Source_Code__c in ('EMRPLCE',
'EMPINET') THEN 'E' 
ELSE 'P' END)+'-'+
(CASE WHEN N1.AS400_Order_Number__c is null then N1.[Name]
else right('00000000000'+cast( cast(replace(N1.AS400_Order_Number__c,'-','') as bigint)+7200000 as varchar),11)
end)+'-'+cast(cast(N2.[Line_Number__c] as numeric) as varchar) ORDER_KEY,
(CASE WHEN Sales_Channel__c='eBay' THEN 'T'
WHEN Sales_Channel__c='Amazon' THEN 'S'
WHEN Source_Code__c in ('EMRPLCE',
'EMPINET') THEN 'E' 
ELSE 'P' END) COMPANY_CODE,
cast('' as varchar(100)) CUSTOMER_NUM,
cast(N1.[Customer__c] as varchar) DEDUP_CUST_MASTER_ID,
cast('' as varchar(100)) SFA_CUST_NUM,
cast(N1.[Ship_To_Address__c] as varchar) OCH_CUST_NUM,
cast('' as varchar(100)) ORD_CUSTOMER_NUM,
(CASE WHEN N1.International_Address__c<> 'No' THEN 'FOREIGN' ELSE 'USA' END) BILL_TO_COUNTRY,
(CASE WHEN N1.International_Address__c<> 'No' THEN 'FOREIGN' ELSE 'USA' END) SHIP_TO_COUNTRY,
N1.[Customer_Name__c] CUSTOMER_NAME,
cast('' as varchar(100)) BILL_TO_TITLE,
cast('' as varchar(200)) BILL_TO_FIRST,
cast('' as varchar(200)) BILL_TO_LAST,
cast('' as varchar(200)) BILL_TO_ADDR1,
cast('' as varchar(200)) BILL_TO_ADDR2,
cast('' as varchar(100)) BILL_TO_ADDR3,
cast('' as varchar(100)) BILL_TO_ADDR4,
cast('' as varchar(200)) BILL_TO_ZIPCODE,
cast('' as varchar(20)) BILL_TO_POSTCODE,
cast('' as varchar(20)) BILL_TO_STATE,
cast('' as varchar(100)) SHIP_TO_TITLE,
N1.[Ship_to_First_Name__c] SHIP_TO_FIRST,
N1.[Ship_To_Last_Name__c] SHIP_TO_LAST,
cast('' as varchar(200)) SHIP_TO_ADDR1,
cast('' as varchar(200)) SHIP_TO_ADDR2,
cast('' as varchar(100)) SHIP_TO_ADDR3,
cast('' as varchar(100)) SHIP_TO_ADDR4,
cast('' as varchar(200))  SHIP_TO_ZIPCODE,
cast('' as varchar(20))  SHIP_TO_POSTCODE,
cast('' as varchar(20))  SHIP_TO_STATE,
cast('' as varchar(20))  ORDER_ORIGIN,
(CASE WHEN N1.[Sales_Channel__c]='Mail' then 'MAIL' WHEN N1.[Sales_Channel__c]='Phone' then 'PHONE' WHEN N1.[Sales_Channel__c]='Brand Website' then 'INTERNET' ELSE 'INTERNET' END) ORDER_CHANNEL,
N1.[Name] WEB_ID,
N1.[Source_Code__c] ORD_SOURCE_CODE,
N1.[Name] ORDER_NUMBER,
right('00000000000'+
cast( cast(replace(N1.AS400_Order_Number__c,'-','') as bigint)+7200000 as varchar),11) AS400_ORDER_NUMBER,
N1.[Payment_Type__c] PAYMENT_METHOD,
cast(1 as numeric) ORDER_NUM_OF_SHIPMENTS,
'' CREDIT_CARD_TYPE,
cast(ISNULL(N1.[Authorization_Amount__c],0) as numeric(18,2)) REMITTED_AMT_USD,
cast(ISNULL(N1.[Order_Sub_Total__c],0) as numeric(18,2)) MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD,
cast(ISNULL(N1.[Tax__c],0)  as numeric(18,2)) TOTAL_TAX_AMT_USD,
cast((ISNULL(N1.[Shipping_Total__c],0)-ISNULL(N1.[Shipping_Discount__c],0))  as numeric(18,2)) TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD,
cast((ISNULL(N1.[Allowance_Discount__c],0)-ISNULL(N1.[Shipping_Discount__c],0))  as numeric(18,2)) TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT_USD,
cast(ISNULL(N1.[Misc_Charge_Amount__c],0)  as numeric(18,2)) TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD,
cast((CASE WHEN N1.[Order_Status__c] ='Shipped/Complete' THEN N1.[Authorization_Amount__c] else 0 end)   as numeric(18,2)) TOTAL_SHIPPED_AMT_USD,
cast((CASE WHEN N1.[Order_Status__c] ='Cancelled' THEN N1.[Authorization_Amount__c] else 0 end)  as numeric(18,2)) TOTAL_REFUND_AMT_USD,
cast(ISNULL(N1.[Authorization_Amount__c],0) as numeric(18,2)) REMITTED_AMT,
cast(ISNULL(N1.[Order_Sub_Total__c],0) as numeric(18,2)) MERCHANDISE_AMT,
cast(ISNULL(N1.[Tax__c],0) as numeric(18,2))  TOTAL_TAX_AMT,
cast((ISNULL(N1.[Shipping_Total__c],0)-ISNULL(N1.[Shipping_Discount__c],0))  as numeric(18,2)) TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT,
cast(ISNULL(N1.[Allowance_Discount__c],0)-ISNULL(N1.[Shipping_Discount__c],0)  as numeric(18,2)) TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT,
cast(ISNULL(N1.[Misc_Charge_Amount__c],0) as numeric(18,2)) TOTAL_MISC_AMT,
cast((CASE WHEN N1.[Order_Status__c] ='Shipped/Complete' THEN N1.[Authorization_Amount__c] else 0 end)  as numeric(18,2)) TOTAL_SHIPPED_AMT,
cast((CASE WHEN N1.[Order_Status__c] ='Cancelled' THEN N1.[Authorization_Amount__c] else 0 end)  as numeric(18,2))  TOTAL_REFUND_AMT,
'' WEB_PRG,
N1.[Primary_Order_Number__c] MASTER_ORDER_NUM,
N1.[Order_Status__c] ORDER_STATUS,
replace(cast(cast(N1.Order_Date__c as date) as varchar),'-','')  ORDER_PROCESS_DATE,
replace(cast(cast(N1.CreatedDate as date) as varchar),'-','')  ORDER_DATE,
(CASE WHEN N1.Personalized__c='1' then 'Y' else null END) VDS_FLAG,
'' COUPON_NUMBER,
(CASE WHEN N1.Personalized__c='1' then 'PN' else null END) VENDOR_CODE,
(CASE WHEN N1.Personalized__c='1' then 'PERSONALIZED NUTRITION' else null END) VENDOR_NAME,
NULL ENTER_QTY,
'' LEGACY_ITEM_PREFIX,
cast(N2.[Line_Number__c] as numeric) ORDER_LINE_NUM,
'' WAREHOUSE,
N2.[Item_Status__c] LINE_STATUS,
N2.[Product_Quantity__c] LIN_QTY,
N2.[Final_Price__c] LINE_NET_PRICE_USD,
N2.[Final_Price__c] LIN_NET_PRICE,
N2.[Quantity_Shipped__c] LIN_SHIPPED_QTY,
N2.[Original_Quantity__c] LIN_ORIG_QTY,
cast(0 as numeric) LIN_BO_QTY,
cast(0 as numeric(18,6)) LIN_FREIGHT_AMT_USD,
cast(0 as numeric(18,6)) LIN_FREIGHT_AMT,
cast(0 as numeric(18,6)) LIN_ALLOWANCE_AMT_USD,
cast(0 as numeric(18,6)) LIN_ALLOWANCE_AMT,
cast(0 as numeric(18,2)) LIN_TAX_AMT_USD,
cast(0 as numeric(18,2)) LIN_TAX_AMT,
cast(N2.[Discount__c]as numeric(18,2)) LIN_DISCOUNT_AMT_USD,
cast(N2.[Discount__c]as numeric(18,2)) LIN_DISCOUNT_AMT,
cast(0 as numeric(18,2)) LIN_UNIT_COST_USD,
cast(0 as numeric(18,2)) LIN_UNIT_COST,
replace(cast(cast(N2.CreatedDate as date) as varchar),'-','') LIN_ORDERED_DATE,
'00000000' LIN_AVAIL_DATE,
'00000000' LIN_BO_DATE,
cast(0 as numeric(18,2)) LIN_NET_AMT_USD,
cast(0 as numeric(18,2)) LIN_GROSS_AMT_USD,
cast(0 as numeric(18,2)) LIN_ADJ_GROSS_PROFIT_USD,
cast(0 as numeric(18,2)) LIN_MERCH_GROSS_PROFIT_USD,
cast(0 as numeric(18,2)) LIN_TOTAL_COST_USD,
(CASE WHEN (ISNULL(N1.Shipping_Total__c,0)+ISNULL(N1.Misc_Charge_Amount__c,0))=0 THEN 'Y'	  ELSE 'N' END) FREE_SHIP_FLAG,
'' VENDOR_SHIPPED_DATE,
replace(cast(cast(N2.Shipped_Date__c as date) as varchar),'-','') LIN_SHIPPED_DATE,
N2.[Item_Buy__c] BUY_FLAG,
N2.[Item_Receive__c] RECEIVE_FLAG,
N2.[Shipment_Tracking_Number__c] TRACKING_NUM,
NULL ENTER_ORC_ITEM_NUM,
N2.[Item_Suffix__c]+'-'+cast(cast(N2.[Product_Number__c] as int) as varchar) ORC_ITEM_NUM,
cast('' as varchar(100)) LOYALTY_NUM,
(CASE WHEN (ISNULL(N1.Shipping_Total__c,0)+ISNULL(N1.Misc_Charge_Amount__c,0))=0 THEN 'Y'	  ELSE 'N' END) FREE_SHIP_IND,
cast(N2.CreatedDate as date) CREATION_DATE,
cast(N2.LastModifiedDate as date) LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
cast(0 as numeric(18,2)) TOTAL_NET_ORD_AMT_USD,
cast('' as varchar(100)) SAP_MATERIAL_NUMBER,
cast('' as varchar(100)) SAP_CUSTOMER_NUMBER
INTO dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder 
from dt.PuritanSalesforceOrders N1, dt.PuritanSalesforceOrderLine N2
where N1.Order_Status__c in ('Shipped/Complete','Back Order','Submitted',
'In Progress','Cancelled')
and N2.IsDeleted <> '1'
and N1.IsDeleted <> '1'
and N1.Id=N2.Order__c
and N1.AS400_Order_Number__c is null;



update dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
set master_order_num=order_number
where master_order_num is null;

update dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
set SAP_MATERIAL_NUMBER=ORC_ITEM_NUM
where DEDUP_CUST_MASTER_ID is not null;

WITH TBCO_REF(SAP_MATERIAL_NUMBER,ORC_ITEM_NUM) AS
(SELECT [Primary Suffix]+'-'+[AS400 #] SAP_MATERIAL_NUMBER,OracleNumber ORC_ITEM_NUM FROM dr.TBCOMaterialMaster
where [Source]='PDH'
and ICC in ('DCI-Display Component','Deals & Display','SMA-Sales & Merchandising Aid','SFG - Vendor Drop Ship','SFG - Consumer Direct',
'Finished Product','FP Retail-Direct Consumer')
group by [Primary Suffix]+'-'+[AS400 #],OracleNumber)
UPDATE  dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
SET ORC_ITEM_NUM=N2.ORC_ITEM_NUM
FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder AS N1
JOIN TBCO_REF AS N2 ON (N1.SAP_MATERIAL_NUMBER=N2.SAP_MATERIAL_NUMBER);

WITH MAT_REF(SAP_MATERIAL_NUMBER,ORC_ITEM_NUM) AS
(SELECT SAPMaterialNumber SAP_MATERIAL_NUMBER,TBCOOracleNumber ORC_ITEM_NUM FROM dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference
group by SAPMaterialNumber,TBCOOracleNumber)
UPDATE  dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
SET SAP_MATERIAL_NUMBER=N2.SAP_MATERIAL_NUMBER
FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder AS N1
JOIN MAT_REF AS N2 ON (N1.ORC_ITEM_NUM=N2.ORC_ITEM_NUM);

WITH CUST_REF(SFA_CUST_NUM,CUSTOMER_NAME,ORDER_KEY,BILL_TO_LAST,BILL_TO_FIRST,BILL_TO_TITLE,BILL_TO_ADDR2,BILL_TO_ADDR3,BILL_TO_STATE,
BILL_TO_ZIPCODE,SHIP_TO_ADDR2,SHIP_TO_ADDR3,SHIP_TO_STATE,
SHIP_TO_ZIPCODE,
LOYALTY_NUM) AS
(select N1.Customer_Number__c SFA_CUST_NUM,N1.[Name] CUSTOMER_NAME,N2.ORDER_KEY,
N1.LastName BILL_TO_LAST,N1.FirstName BILL_TO_FIRST,N1.Salutation BILL_TO_TITLE,N1.BillingStreet BILL_TO_ADDR2,
N1.BillingCity BILL_TO_ADDR3,ISNULL(N1.BillingState,'FO') BILL_TO_STATE,ISNULL(N1.BillingPostalCode,'0')
BILL_TO_ZIPCODE,
N1.ShippingStreet SHIP_TO_ADDR2,
N1.ShippingCity SHIP_TO_ADDR3,ISNULL(N1.ShippingState,'FO') SHIP_TO_STATE,ISNULL(N1.ShippingPostalCode,'0') 
SHIP_TO_ZIPCODE,
N1.Loyalty_ID__c LOYALTY_NUM from dr.DimPuritanSalesforceAccount N1,
dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder N2
where N1.ID=N2.DEDUP_CUST_MASTER_ID
)
update dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
set SFA_CUST_NUM=N2.SFA_CUST_NUM,
CUSTOMER_NUM=N2.SFA_CUST_NUM,
ORD_CUSTOMER_NUM=N2.SFA_CUST_NUM,
CUSTOMER_NAME=N2.CUSTOMER_NAME,
BILL_TO_LAST=N2.BILL_TO_LAST,
BILL_TO_FIRST=N2.BILL_TO_FIRST,
BILL_TO_TITLE=N2.BILL_TO_TITLE,
BILL_TO_ADDR2=N2.BILL_TO_ADDR2,
BILL_TO_ADDR3=N2.BILL_TO_ADDR3,
BILL_TO_STATE=N2.BILL_TO_STATE,
BILL_TO_ZIPCODE=N2.BILL_TO_ZIPCODE,
SHIP_TO_ADDR2=N2.SHIP_TO_ADDR2,
SHIP_TO_ADDR3=N2.SHIP_TO_ADDR3,
SHIP_TO_STATE=N2.SHIP_TO_STATE,
SHIP_TO_ZIPCODE=N2.SHIP_TO_ZIPCODE,
LOYALTY_NUM=N2.LOYALTY_NUM
FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder AS N1
JOIN CUST_REF AS N2 ON (N1.ORDER_KEY=N2.ORDER_KEY);

update dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder 
set ord_source_code=LEFT(ord_source_code + space(7), 7)+'P'
where sfa_cust_num='';

update dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
set ord_source_code=LEFT(ord_source_code + space(7), 7)+'P'
WHERE ORDER_NUMBER  in 
(select ORDER_NUMBER from dr.PuritanNTFOrders group by ORDER_NUMBER);

update dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
set ord_source_code=LEFT(ord_source_code + space(7), 7)+'P'
FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder AS N1
WHERE SFA_CUST_NUM not in 
(select SFA_CUST_NUM from dr.FactPuritanSalesOrder N2
where cast(N2.order_process_date as date)>=getdate()-1100
and sfa_cust_num is not null and sfa_cust_num <> ''
and ORDER_STATUS NOT                IN ('RX','RC', 'RW','PW','PX','VC','VF','VG','VW','VX','PB','BV','Cancelled')
AND LINE_STATUS NOT                 IN ('RX','RC', 'RW','PW','PX','VC','VF','VG','VW','VX','PB','BV','Item Cancelled','CANCELLED')  
);



update  dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder 
set SAP_CUSTOMER_NUMBER=
(CASE WHEN CREDIT_CARD_TYPE IS NOT NULL and ORDER_CHANNEL='INTERNET' and COMPANY_CODE='P'
THEN '0000015890-NHS Puritans Pride CC Orders'
WHEN CREDIT_CARD_TYPE IS NOT NULL and ORDER_CHANNEL<>'INTERNET' and COMPANY_CODE='P' THEN '0000015889-NHS Mail Order CC'
WHEN  COMPANY_CODE='T' THEN '0000015938-NHS EBAY Orders'
WHEN  COMPANY_CODE='E' THEN 'NHS Associates'
WHEN CREDIT_CARD_TYPE IS  NULL and ORDER_CHANNEL<>'INTERNET' THEN '0000015888-NHS Mail Order Check'
ELSE '0000015890-NHS Puritans Pride CC Orders' END
);




WITH STDCOST(ORC_ITEM_NUM,[Month-Year],LIN_UNIT_COST,LIN_UNIT_COST_USD) AS
(select   [EBS Item No.] ORC_ITEM_NUM,[Month-Year],
CAST(ISNULL(TOTAL_ITEM_COST,0) AS DEC(20,4))  LIN_UNIT_COST, CAST(ISNULL(TOTAL_ITEM_COST,0)  AS DEC(20,4))  
LIN_UNIT_COST_USD  from dr.TBCOStandardCost where [Organization Code]='003'
and cast(cast([Month-Year] as varchar)+'01' as date) >=getdate()-300
group by [EBS Item No.],[Month-Year],TOTAL_ITEM_COST)
UPDATE  dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
SET LIN_UNIT_COST=N2.LIN_UNIT_COST,
LIN_UNIT_COST_USD=N2.LIN_UNIT_COST_USD
FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder AS N1
JOIN STDCOST AS N2 ON (N1.ORC_ITEM_NUM=N2.ORC_ITEM_NUM
and substring(N1.order_date,1,6)=N2.[Month-Year]);





WITH MERCH_LINE(Order_Number,MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD) AS (select Order_Number,cast(sum(
CASE WHEN Line_Status not in ('Item Cancelled',
'CANCELLED') THEN LINE_NET_PRICE_USD
ELSE 0 END) as dec(10,2))  from dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
where Order_Number  in 
(SELECT Order_Number FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder where Order_Status not in
(
'Error Screen',
'Bad Order',
'Cancelled')
and cast(MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)) >0
and Line_Status in ('Item Cancelled',
'CANCELLED')
and cast(order_process_date as date) >=getdate()-300
group by Order_Number
)
group by ORDER_NUMBER
having count(*) > 1
)
UPDATE  dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
SET MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD=N2.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD,
MERCHANDISE_AMT=N2.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD
FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder AS N1
JOIN MERCH_LINE AS N2 ON (N1.Order_Number=N2.Order_Number);




WITH PROR(Order_Number,MERCHANDISE_AMT,MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD,TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT,TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD,TOTAL_MISC_AMT,TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD) AS (
SELECT N1.Order_Number, 
CAST(N1.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)) MERCHANDISE_AMT,
CAST(N1.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)) MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD,
CAST(N1.TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)) TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT,
CAST(N1.TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)) TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD,
CAST(N1.TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)) TOTAL_MISC_AMT,
CAST(N1.TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)) TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD
FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder  N1
WHERE CAST(N1.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)) >0
AND (cast(N1.TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)) +cast(N1.TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)))  >0 AND ISNULL(Order_Status,'NA') not in
('Error Screen',
'Bad Order',
'Cancelled')
and cast(order_process_date as date) >=getdate()-300
group by Order_Number,MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD,TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD,TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD)
UPDATE  dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
set  LIN_FREIGHT_AMT =cast(( N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD /N2.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD)*(N2.TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD+N2.TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD) as dec(19,10))
,LIN_FREIGHT_AMT_USD=cast(( N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD/N2.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD)*(N2.TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD+N2.TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD) as dec(19,10))
FROM
 dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder  AS N1
JOIN PROR AS N2 ON (N1.Order_Number=N2.Order_Number)
WHERE N1.Line_Status not in ('Item Cancelled',
'CANCELLED')
AND CAST(N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD as dec(10,4)) > 0;


WITH ALLOW(ORDER_NUMBER,TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT,MERCHANDISE_AMT,MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD) AS (select 
N1.ORDER_NUMBER,N1.TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT,SUM(cast(N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD as dec(10,2))) MERCHANDISE_AMT,
SUM(cast(N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD as dec(10,2))) MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD
 FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder N1, dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N2
where  CAST(N1.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD as dec(10,2))  >0
and CAST(N1.TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)) >0
and CAST(N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD as dec(10,2)) >0
and N1.ORC_ITEM_NUM=N2.OracleNumber
and N2.[Source]='PDH'
AND UPPER(N2.ICC) not in ('SFG - CONSUMER DIRECT','SFG - VENDOR DROP SHIP')
and ISNULL(N1.ORDER_STATUS,'NA') not in  (
'Error Screen',
'Bad Order',
'Cancelled')
AND N1.LINE_STATUS NOT IN  ('Item Cancelled',
'CANCELLED')
group by N1.order_number,N1.TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT
union
select 
N1.ORDER_NUMBER,N1.TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT,SUM(cast(N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD as dec(10,2))) MERCHANDISE_AMT,
SUM(cast(N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD as dec(10,2))) MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD
 FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder N1, dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N2
where  CAST(N1.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD as dec(10,2))  >0
and CAST(N1.TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT_USD as dec(10,2)) >0
and CAST(N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD as dec(10,2)) >0
and N1.ORC_ITEM_NUM=N2.OracleNumber
and N2.[Source]='PDH'
AND UPPER(N2.ICC)  in ('SFG - CONSUMER DIRECT','SFG - VENDOR DROP SHIP')
and ISNULL(N1.ORDER_STATUS,'NA') not in  (
'Error Screen',
'Bad Order',
'Cancelled')
AND N1.LINE_STATUS NOT IN  ('Item Cancelled',
'CANCELLED')
AND NOT EXISTS
(SELECT 'X' FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder N4,dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N5
WHERE N4.order_number=N1.ORDER_NUMber
and N4.ORC_ITEM_NUM=N5.OracleNumber
and N5.[Source]='PDH'
AND UPPER(N5.ICC) not in ('SFG - CONSUMER DIRECT','SFG - VENDOR DROP SHIP')
and CAST(N4.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD AS DEC(10,2)) >0
AND N1.LINE_STATUS NOT IN  ('Item Cancelled',
'CANCELLED'))
group by N1.order_number,N1.TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT

) 
UPDATE dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
set LIN_ALLOWANCE_AMT=cast(N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD/CAST(N2.MERCHANDISE_AMT AS DEC(10,2))*N2.TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT as numeric(19,9))
,LIN_ALLOWANCE_AMT_USD=cast (N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD/CAST(N2.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD  AS DEC(10,2))*N2.TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT as numeric(19,9))
FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder N1
JOIN ALLOW AS N2 ON (N1.order_number=N2.order_number);



WITH ALLOW1(ORDER_NUMBER,order_line_num,ORC_ITEM_NUM) AS (select 
N1.ORDER_NUMBER,N1.order_line_num,N1.ORC_ITEM_NUM
 FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder N1, dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N2
where    CAST(N1.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD as dec(10,2))  >0
and CAST(N1.TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT as dec(10,2)) >0
and CAST(N1.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD as dec(10,2)) >0
AND N2.OracleNumber=N1.ORC_ITEM_NUM
AND UPPER(N2.ICC) in ('SFG - CONSUMER DIRECT','SFG - VENDOR DROP SHIP')
and ISNULL(N1.ORDER_STATUS,'NA') not in  (
'Error Screen',
'Bad Order',
'Cancelled')
AND N1.LINE_STATUS NOT IN  ('Item Cancelled',
'CANCELLED')AND  EXISTS
(SELECT 'X' FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder N4, dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N5
WHERE  N5.OracleNumber=N4.ORC_ITEM_NUM
and N4.ORDER_NUMBER=N1.ORDER_NUMBER
AND UPPER(N5.ICC) not in ('SFG - CONSUMER DIRECT','SFG - VENDOR DROP SHIP')
and CAST(N4.LINE_NET_PRICE_USD as dec(10,2)) >0
AND N4.LINE_STATUS NOT IN  ('Item Cancelled',
'CANCELLED'))
group by N1.ORDER_NUMBER,N1.order_line_num,N1.ORC_ITEM_NUM)
UPDATE dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder 
set LIN_ALLOWANCE_AMT =0
,LIN_ALLOWANCE_AMT_USD=0
FROM dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder AS  N1 
JOIN ALLOW1 AS N2
ON (N1.order_number=N2.order_number
and N1.order_line_num=N2.order_line_num
and N1.ORC_ITEM_NUM=N2.ORC_ITEM_NUM);



UPDATE dt.FactPuritanSalesOrder
SET TOTAL_NET_ORD_AMT_USD=(MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD-cast(TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT as dec(10,2))+cast(TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT as dec(10,2))+cast(TOTAL_MISC_AMT as dec(10,2))) ,
LIN_TOTAL_COST_USD=(CAST(LIN_QTY as dec(10,2))-cast(LIN_BO_QTY as dec(10,2)))*LIN_UNIT_COST_USD,
LIN_NET_AMT_USD=(LIN_NET_PRICE-LIN_ALLOWANCE_AMT+LIN_FREIGHT_AMT) ,
LIN_GROSS_AMT_USD=(LIN_NET_PRICE+LIN_ALLOWANCE_AMT) ,
 LIN_ADJ_GROSS_PROFIT_USD=(LIN_NET_PRICE-LIN_ALLOWANCE_AMT+LIN_FREIGHT_AMT)-((CAST(LIN_QTY as dec(10,2))-cast(LIN_BO_QTY as dec(10,2)))*LIN_UNIT_COST_USD),
LIN_MERCH_GROSS_PROFIT_USD=(LIN_NET_PRICE)-(CAST(LIN_QTY as dec(10,2))-cast(LIN_BO_QTY as dec(10,2)))*LIN_UNIT_COST_USD 
;

drop table dr.PuritanTransactionSummary;

END;

SELECT
      (CASE WHEN N1.COMPANY_CODE='P' then 'PURITAN''S PRIDE'
        WHEN N1.COMPANY_CODE='S' then 'AMAZON ORDERS'
        WHEN N1.COMPANY_CODE='E' then 'ASSOCIATE/PURITAN''S PRIDE'
        WHEN N1.COMPANY_CODE='T' then 'EBAY ORDERS' END
      ) BANNER,
      CONVERT(DATE,N1.ORDER_DATE,112) ORDER_DATE,
      (CASE WHEN N1.ORD_SOURCE_CODE IN ('REPLACE', 'PPRPLCE', 'EMRPLCE', 'EMPRPLC', 'AZRPLCE','VCOMREP') AND N1.ORD_SOURCE_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
      WHEN N1.ORD_SOURCE_CODE IN ('REPLACEP', 'PPRPLCEP', 'EMRPLCEP', 'EMPRPLCP', 'AZRPLCEP','VCOMREPP') AND N1.ORD_SOURCE_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N' END) REPLACEMENT_ORD_FLAG,
      N1.CUSTOMER_NUM,
      CONVERT(DATE,N1.ORDER_PROCESS_DATE,112) ORDER_PROCESS_DATE,
      N1.ORDER_NUMBER,
      N1.MASTER_ORDER_NUM,
      (CASE WHEN N3.website_id ='53' or N3.ES_SOURCE_IND='1' THEN 'YES'
      ELSE 'NO' END ) ES_FLAG,
      N1.BILL_TO_COUNTRY,
      N1.SHIP_TO_COUNTRY,
      (CASE WHEN N1.BILL_TO_STATE='FO' THEN 'FOREIGN'
      WHEN N1.BILL_TO_STATE IS  NULL THEN 'OTHER'
      ELSE N1.BILL_TO_STATE END) BILL_TO_STATE,
      (CASE WHEN N1.SHIP_TO_STATE='FO' THEN 'FOREIGN'
      WHEN N1.SHIP_TO_STATE IS  NULL THEN 'OTHER'
      ELSE N1.SHIP_TO_STATE END) SHIP_TO_STATE,
      (case when N2.[Brand Code]='PN' or N1.[VENDOR_CODE]='PN' THEN 'PERSONALIZED NUTRITION'
	  ELSE N1.ORDER_CHANNEL
	  END) ORDER_CHANNEL,
      (
      CASE WHEN N1.ORDER_CHANNEL in ('MAIL','PHONE') and N3.PROMO_CHANNEL <> 'SPECIAL ORDERS' THEN N1.ORDER_CHANNEL
      WHEN N3.PROMO_NAME='LOYALTY' THEN 'LOYALTY'
      WHEN N3.PROMO_CHANNEL='PLA' THEN 'GOOGLE PLA'
      WHEN N3.PROMO_CHANNEL='UNKNOWN' THEN 'OTHER'
      ELSE N3.PROMO_CHANNEL END
      ) PROMO_CHANNEL ,
      N3.PROMO_CHANNEL SOURCE_CHANNEL,
	  N3.NTF_FLAG,
      ISNULL(N3.VENDOR_NAME,'NO PROMO VENDOR') PROMO_VENDOR_NAME,
      N3.SEGMENT_NAME,
      N3.PROMOTION_CODE,
      N3.PROMOTION_NUM,
      N3.OFFER_NAME,
      N3.PROMO_DESC,
      N1.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD,
      N1.TOTAL_TAX_AMT_USD,
      N1.TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD,
      N1.TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT_USD,
      N1.TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD,
      N1.TOTAL_NET_ORD_AMT_USD,
	  N3.promo_cost,
	  N3.promo_circulation,
      N1.TOTAL_REFUND_AMT_USD,
      CASE WHEN (N1.TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD+N1.TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD)=0 THEN 'Y'
	  ELSE 'N' END FREE_SHIP_IND,
      ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(N1.LIN_FREIGHT_AMT_USD),0),2) PRORATED_SHIP_AMT,
      ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(N1.LIN_ALLOWANCE_AMT_USD),0),2) PRORATED_ALLOW_AMT,
      SUM(N1.LIN_TOTAL_COST_USD) TOTAL_LINE_COST_USD,
      (N1.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD  -SUM(N1.LIN_TOTAL_COST_USD)) MERCH_GROSS_PROFIT,
      (N1.TOTAL_NET_ORD_AMT_USD-SUM(N1.LIN_TOTAL_COST_USD)) GROSS_PROFIT,
       ISNULL(N1.BILL_TO_ZIPCODE,'0') BILL_TO_ZIPCODE,
      ISNULL(N1.SHIP_TO_ZIPCODE,'0') SHIP_TO_ZIPCODE,N1.LOYALTY_NUM,
	  N3.CAMPAIGN_NAME
    INTO dr.PuritanTransactionSummary
    FROM dr.FactPuritanSalesOrder N1  INNER JOIN 
         dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N2 ON (N1.ORC_ITEM_NUM =N2.[OracleNumber]) LEFT OUTER JOIN
         dr.DimPuritanPromotion N3
    ON ( N1.COMPANY_CODE  =N3.[COMPANY_CODE]
    AND N1.ORD_SOURCE_CODE =N3.promotion_code)
      WHERE ISNULL(N2.ICC,'NA')                   not in ( 'DCI-Display Component','SMA-Sales & Merchandising Aid')
      AND ISNULL(N2.[Super Category],'NA')        <> 'NON SALEABLE'
      AND CONVERT(DATE,N1.ORDER_PROCESS_DATE,112) > getdate()-1100
      AND 
      (CASE WHEN N1.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD              > 0 THEN 'Y'
      WHEN N1.ORD_SOURCE_CODE IN ('REPLACE', 'PPRPLCE', 'EMRPLCE', 'EMPRPLC', 'AZRPLCE','VCOMREP') AND N1.ORD_SOURCE_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
      WHEN N1.ORD_SOURCE_CODE IN ('REPLACEP', 'PPRPLCEP', 'EMRPLCEP', 'EMPRPLCP', 'AZRPLCEP','VCOMREPP') AND N1.ORD_SOURCE_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N' END) ='Y'
      AND N1.ORDER_STATUS NOT                IN ('RX','RC', 'RW','PW','PX','VC','VF','VG','VW','VX','PB','BV','Back Order','Cancelled')
      AND N1.LINE_STATUS NOT                 IN ('RX','RC', 'RW','PW','PX','VC','VF','VG','VW','VX','PB','BV','Back Order','Item Cancelled','CANCELLED')
    GROUP BY N1.COMPANY_CODE,
      N1.ORDER_DATE,
      N1.ORDER_PROCESS_DATE,
	  N3.promo_cost,
	  N3.promo_circulation,
      N1.ORDER_NUMBER,
      N1.MASTER_ORDER_NUM,
      N1.CUSTOMER_NUM,
      N3.WEBSITE_ID,
      N1.ORD_SOURCE_CODE,
      N3.ES_SOURCE_IND,
      ISNULL(N1.BILL_TO_ZIPCODE,'0'),
      ISNULL(N1.SHIP_TO_ZIPCODE,'0'),
(CASE WHEN N1.BILL_TO_STATE='FO' THEN 'FOREIGN'
      WHEN N1.BILL_TO_STATE IS  NULL THEN 'OTHER'
      ELSE N1.BILL_TO_STATE END),
      (CASE WHEN N1.SHIP_TO_STATE='FO' THEN 'FOREIGN'
      WHEN N1.SHIP_TO_STATE IS  NULL THEN 'OTHER'
      ELSE N1.SHIP_TO_STATE END),
      N1.ORDER_CHANNEL,
      N3.PROMO_CHANNEL,
	     (case when N2.[Brand Code]='PN' or N1.[VENDOR_CODE]='PN' THEN 'PERSONALIZED NUTRITION'
	  ELSE N1.ORDER_CHANNEL
	  END),
      ISNULL(N3.VENDOR_NAME,'NO PROMO VENDOR'),
      N3.SEGMENT_NAME,
      N3.PROMOTION_CODE,
      N3.PROMOTION_NUM,
      N3.OFFER_NAME,
      N3.PROMO_DESC,
	  N3.NTF_FLAG,
      N3.Promo_Name,
      N1.MERCHANDISE_AMT_USD,
      N1.TOTAL_TAX_AMT_USD,
      N1.TOTAL_FREIGHT_AMT_USD,
      N1.TOTAL_ALLOWANCE_AMT_USD,
      N1.BILL_TO_COUNTRY,

      N1.TOTAL_MISC_AMT_USD,
      N1.TOTAL_NET_ORD_AMT_USD,N1.TOTAL_REFUND_AMT_USD,N1.LOYALTY_NUM,
	  N3.CAMPAIGN_NAME;     

	  IF OBJECT_ID('dr.TBCOPuritanTransactionSummary','U') IS NOT NULL

	  truncate table dr.TBCOPuritanTransactionSummary;

truncate table dr.PuritanBatchReconciliations;

insert into dr.PuritanBatchReconciliations
select a.Batch_Number__c as BatchNumber, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.Order_Status__c = 'Cancelled' THEN NULL
else a.[Name] END ) as Orders, sum(
CASE WHEN a.Order_Status__c <> 'Cancelled' THEN a.Payment_Value__c
ELSE 0 END) as BatchTotal,
COUNT(CASE WHEN a.Order_Status__c <> 'Cancelled' THEN NULL
else a.[Name] END ) as CancelledOrders,
try_convert(date,substring(a.Batch_Number__c,5,2)+substring(a.Batch_Number__c,1,4),1 ) [Date]
from dt.PuritanSalesforceOrders a
where try_convert(date,substring(a.Batch_Number__c,5,2)+substring(a.Batch_Number__c,1,4),1 )>=cast(getdate()-15 as date)
--and a.Pull_Order__c = 'false'
--and a.Order_Status__c <> 'Cancelled'
and Order_Confirm_Brand__c <> 'Vitamin World'
and Payment_Type__c <> 'Wire Transfer'
group by a.Batch_Number__c;

truncate table dr.PuritanBatchReconciliationsCancelledReasons;

insert into dr.PuritanBatchReconciliationsCancelledReasons
select a.Batch_Number__c as BatchNumber, a.Name, a.Order_Total__c as OrderTotal, b.Name as LastModifiedBy, a.Cancelled_Reason__c,
try_convert(date,substring(a.Batch_Number__c,5,2)+substring(a.Batch_Number__c,1,4),1 ) [Date]
from dt.PuritanSalesforceOrders a
inner join dr.DimPuritanSalesforceUser b
on a.LastModifiedById = b.Id
where try_convert(date,substring(a.Batch_Number__c,5,2)+substring(a.Batch_Number__c,1,4),1 ) >=cast(getdate()-15 as date)
and Order_Status__c = 'Cancelled'
and Order_Confirm_Brand__c <> 'Vitamin World'
and Payment_Type__c <> 'Wire Transfer'
and Order_Total__c > 0;

text.value:
DELETE D FROM [dr].[GOL_NPG_Revenue] D
  JOIN
	(SELECT DISTINCT
						 [PERIOD_NAME]
						,[PERIOD_NUMBER]
						, MC.MaxCreation
	  FROM 
						[dr].[GOL_NPG_Revenue] R
	  JOIN
			(	SELECT 
						MAX([Creation_Date]) MaxCreation 
				FROM	
						[dr].[GOL_NPG_Revenue] 
				WHERE 
						CONVERT(DATE,[Creation_Date])=CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())
			) MC ON MC.[MaxCreation]=R.[Creation_Date]
	) I
  ON D.[PERIOD_NAME]=I.[PERIOD_NAME]
  and D.[PERIOD_NUMBER]=I.[PERIOD_NUMBER]
  and D.[Creation_Date]<>I.[MaxCreation]

scripts.text:
WITH MultipleLoads AS (
						SELECT  
								 [Creation_Date]
								,[INVOICE_PERIOD]
								,RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY [INVOICE_PERIOD] ORDER BY [Creation_Date] DESC) AS RN
						FROM 
								[dr].[GOL_SKU_Revenue]
						GROUP BY 
								[Creation_Date],[INVOICE_PERIOD]
						)

DELETE 
		GOL 
FROM 
		[dr].[GOL_SKU_Revenue] GOL
JOIN 
		MultipleLoads M ON M.[Creation_Date]=GOL.[Creation_Date] AND M.[INVOICE_PERIOD]=GOL.[INVOICE_PERIOD]
WHERE 
		M.RN>1

activities.name: PuritanCustomerSegmentScript
activities.description: Script to process the data of Puritan Customer Segment

scripts.text:
declare @snapshotmonth date;
set @snapshotmonth=cast(DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0) as date);

delete from dr.PuritanSalesForceCustomerCategory where CustomerCategoryMonth=@snapshotmonth;

insert into dr.PuritanSalesForceCustomerCategory
(CustomerCategoryMonth,SalesForceAccountID,CustomerType,
CustomerCategory,CustomerSubCategory,CustomerAttribute1,CustomerAttribute2,SalesForceAccountNumber,
FirstOrderDate
)
select  
@snapshotmonth CustomerCategoryMonth,
N1.Customer__c SalesForceAccountID,
N2.[Type] CustomerType,
'Non-Active' CustomerCategory,
'Lapsed' CustomerSubCategory,
'Lapsed' CustomerAttribute1,
'Lapsed' CustomerAttribute2,
N2.[Customer_Number__c] SalesForceAccountNumber
,cast(N2.First_Order_Date_Sum__c as date) FirstOrderDate
from dr.PuritanSalesForceOrders N1,
dr.DimPuritanSalesforceAccount N2
where year(cast(N1.Order_Date__c as date)) =year(dateadd(month,-13,@snapshotmonth))
and month(cast(N1.Order_Date__c as date))=month(dateadd(month,-13,@snapshotmonth))
and N1.Sales_Channel__c <>'eBay'
and (N1.Shipedge_Order_Number__c is not null or N1.AS400_Order_Number__c is  not null
or N1.Order_Status__c = 'Shipped/Complete')
and N1.Order_Status__c not in ('Cancelled','Back Order','Cancel Failed','Refund Failed',
'Submission Failed','Error Screen','Pending Vendor Verification','Bad Order')
and N2.ID=N1.Customer__c
and not exists (select 'X' from dr.PuritanSalesForceOrders N3 
where N1.Customer__c=N3.Customer__c
and N3.Sales_Channel__c <>'eBay'
and cast(N3.Order_Date__c as date) >=dateadd(month,-12,@snapshotmonth)
and cast(N3.Order_Date__c as date) <dateadd(month,0,@snapshotmonth)
and cast(ISNULL(N3.[Order_Sub_Total__c],0) as numeric(18,2))>0
and (N3.Shipedge_Order_Number__c is not null or N3.AS400_Order_Number__c is  not null
or N3.Order_Status__c = 'Shipped/Complete')
and N3.Order_Status__c not in ('Cancelled','Back Order','Cancel Failed','Refund Failed',
'Submission Failed','Error Screen','Pending Vendor Verification','Bad Order'))
and cast(ISNULL(N1.[Order_Sub_Total__c],0) as numeric(18,2))>0
group by N1.Customer__c,N2.First_Order_Date_Sum__c,
N2.[Type],N2.[Customer_Number__c];

insert into dr.PuritanSalesForceCustomerCategory
(CustomerCategoryMonth,SalesForceAccountID,CustomerType,
CustomerCategory,CustomerSubCategory,CustomerAttribute1,CustomerAttribute2,SalesForceAccountNumber,
FirstOrderDate
)
select  
@snapshotmonth CustomerCategoryMonth,
N1.Customer__c SalesForceAccountID,
N2.[Type] CustomerType,
'Active' CustomerCategory,
'New Customer' CustomerSubCategory,
'New Customer' CustomerAttribute1,
'Never Bought' CustomerAttribute2,
N2.[Customer_Number__c] SalesForceAccountNumber
,cast(N2.First_Order_Date_Sum__c as date) FirstOrderDate
from dr.PuritanSalesForceOrders N1,
dr.DimPuritanSalesforceAccount N2
where month(cast(N1.Order_Date__c as date)) =month(dateadd(month,-1,@snapshotmonth))
and year(cast(N1.Order_Date__c as date)) =year(dateadd(month,-1,@snapshotmonth))
and N1.Sales_Channel__c <>'eBay'
and (N1.Shipedge_Order_Number__c is not null or N1.AS400_Order_Number__c is  not null
or N1.Order_Status__c = 'Shipped/Complete')
and N1.Order_Status__c not in ('Cancelled','Back Order','Cancel Failed','Refund Failed',
'Submission Failed','Error Screen','Pending Vendor Verification','Bad Order')
and month(cast(N2.First_Order_Date_Sum__C as date))=month(dateadd(month,-1,@snapshotmonth))
and year(cast(N2.First_Order_Date_Sum__C as date)) =year(dateadd(month,-1,@snapshotmonth))
and N2.ID=N1.Customer__c
and cast(ISNULL(N1.[Order_Sub_Total__c],0) as numeric(18,2))>0
and  not exists
(select 'X' from dr.PuritanSalesForceOrders N3
where N3.Customer__c=N1.Customer__c
and N3.Sales_Channel__c <>'eBay'
and cast(N3.Order_Date__c as date) <dateadd(month,-1,@snapshotmonth)
and (N3.Shipedge_Order_Number__c is not null or N3.AS400_Order_Number__c is  not null
or N3.Order_Status__c = 'Shipped/Complete')
and N3.Order_Status__c not in ('Cancelled','Back Order','Cancel Failed','Refund Failed',
'Submission Failed','Error Screen','Pending Vendor Verification','Bad Order')
and cast(ISNULL(N3.[Order_Sub_Total__c],0) as numeric(18,2))>0
)
group by N1.Customer__c,N2.First_Order_Date_Sum__c,
N2.[Type],N2.[Customer_Number__c];

insert into dr.PuritanSalesForceCustomerCategory
(CustomerCategoryMonth,SalesForceAccountID,CustomerType,
CustomerCategory,CustomerSubCategory,CustomerAttribute1,CustomerAttribute2,SalesForceAccountNumber,
FirstOrderDate
)
select  
@snapshotmonth CustomerCategoryMonth,
N1.Customer__c SalesForceAccountID,
N2.[Type] CustomerType,
'Active' CustomerCategory,
'New Customer' CustomerSubCategory,
'New Customer' CustomerAttribute1,
'New Customer ' CustomerAttribute2,
N2.[Customer_Number__c] SalesForceAccountNumber
,cast(N2.First_Order_Date_Sum__c as date) FirstOrderDate
from dr.PuritanSalesForceOrders N1,
dr.DimPuritanSalesforceAccount N2
where month(cast(N1.Order_Date__c as date)) =month(dateadd(month,-1,@snapshotmonth))
and year(cast(N1.Order_Date__c as date)) =year(dateadd(month,-1,@snapshotmonth))
and N1.Sales_Channel__c <>'eBay'
and  not exists
(select 'X' from dr.PuritanSalesForceCustomerCategory N3
where N3.SalesForceAccountID=N1.Customer__c
and N3.CustomerCategoryMonth=@snapshotmonth
)
and (N1.Shipedge_Order_Number__c is not null or N1.AS400_Order_Number__c is  not null
or N1.Order_Status__c = 'Shipped/Complete')
and N1.Order_Status__c not in ('Cancelled','Back Order','Cancel Failed','Refund Failed',
'Submission Failed','Error Screen','Pending Vendor Verification','Bad Order')
and cast(ISNULL(N1.[Order_Sub_Total__c],0) as numeric(18,2))>0
and not exists
(select 'X' from dr.PuritanSalesForceOrders N3
where (N3.Shipedge_Order_Number__c is not null or N3.AS400_Order_Number__c is  not null
or N3.Order_Status__c = 'Shipped/Complete')
and N3.Order_Status__c not in ('Cancelled','Back Order','Cancel Failed','Refund Failed',

and cast(ISNULL(N3.[Order_Sub_Total__c],0) as numeric(18,2))>0
and cast(N3.Order_Date__c as date) <dateadd(month,-1,@snapshotmonth)
and cast(N3.Order_Date__c as date) >=dateadd(month,-13,@snapshotmonth)
and N3.Sales_Channel__c <>'eBay')
and N2.ID=N1.Customer__c
group by N1.Customer__c,N2.First_Order_Date_Sum__c,
N2.[Type],N2.[Customer_Number__c];

insert into dr.PuritanSalesForceCustomerCategory
(CustomerCategoryMonth,SalesForceAccountID,CustomerType,
CustomerCategory,CustomerSubCategory,CustomerAttribute1,CustomerAttribute2,SalesForceAccountNumber,
FirstOrderDate
)
select  
@snapshotmonth CustomerCategoryMonth,
N1.Customer__c SalesForceAccountID,
N2.[Type] CustomerType,
'Active' CustomerCategory,

'Risk To Churn' CustomerAttribute1,

from dr.PuritanSalesForceOrders N1,

where cast(N1.Order_Date__c as date) >=dateadd(month,-12,@snapshotmonth)
and cast(N1.Order_Date__c as date) <dateadd(month,-4,@snapshotmonth)
and cast(ISNULL(N1.[Order_Sub_Total__c],0) as numeric(18,2))>0
and (N1.Shipedge_Order_Number__c is not null or N1.AS400_Order_Number__c is  not null
or N1.Order_Status__c = 'Shipped/Complete')
and N1.Order_Status__c not in ('Cancelled','Back Order','Cancel Failed','Refund Failed',
'Submission Failed','Error Screen','Pending Vendor Verification','Bad Order')
and N1.Sales_Channel__c <>'eBay'
and not exists
(select 'X' from dr.PuritanSalesForceOrders N3
where  (N3.Shipedge_Order_Number__c is not null or N3.AS400_Order_Number__c is  not null
or N3.Order_Status__c = 'Shipped/Complete')
and N3.Order_Status__c not in ('Cancelled','Back Order','Cancel Failed','Refund Failed',
'Submission Failed','Error Screen','Pending Vendor Verification','Bad Order')
and cast(ISNULL(N3.[Order_Sub_Total__c],0) as numeric(18,2))>0
and N3.Customer__c=N1.Customer__c

)
and N2.ID=N1.Customer__c
group by N1.Customer__c,N2.First_Order_Date_Sum__c,

WITH A AS(
SELECT DISTINCT
o.[Name] AS Order_Number,
	   COALESCE(o.AS400_Order_Number__c,'') AS AS400_Order_Number,
	   COALESCE(o.Shipedge_Order_Number__c,'') AS Shipedge_Order_Number,
	   CONVERT(DATE,l.Shipped_Date__c , 101) AS Shipped_Date,
	   l.Product_Number__c as Item_Number,
	   i.name as Item_Description,
	   Quantity_Shipped__c as Quantity_Shipped,
	   Final_Price__c as Final_Price,
	   aa.Customer_Number__c as Customer_Number,

	   Concat(COALESCE(a.Address_Line_1__c,aa.ShippingStreet),' ',
	          COALESCE(a.City__c,aa.ShippingCity),', ', 
             (CASE WHEN aa.ShippingState = 'FO' THEN ''
	         WHEN ShippingCountry = 'CH'THEN ''
	         ELSE aa.ShippingState 
		     END),' ',
			 (CASE WHEN aa.ShippingState = 'FO' THEN a.Foreign_Postal_Code__c
       	      WHEN ShippingCountry = 'CH' AND COALESCE( a.City__c,aa.ShippingCity) =  'Prangins' THEN '1197'
	          ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(a.Zip_Code__c,aa.ShippingPostalCode),
			             (CASE WHEN a.Zip_Code_4__c  IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' END),
			              COALESCE(a.Zip_Code_4__c, '' )) 
		      END), ' ',
			 ShippingCountry) AS Ship_To_Address,			  
       COALESCE( a.City__c,aa.ShippingCity) AS City,
      (CASE WHEN aa.ShippingState = 'FO' THEN ''
	         WHEN ShippingCountry = 'CH'THEN ''
	         ELSE aa.ShippingState 
		END) State,
	   (Case when (CASE WHEN ShippingCountry = 'CH' Then 'SWITZERLAND'Else a.Country_Picklist__c END) = 'UNITED STATES' Then '' 
	   ELSE	COALESCE(a.Address_Line_4__c,' ')END)Providence,
	   (CASE WHEN aa.ShippingState = 'FO' THEN a.Foreign_Postal_Code__c
       	      WHEN ShippingCountry = 'CH' AND COALESCE( a.City__c,aa.ShippingCity) =  'Prangins' THEN '1197'
	          ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(a.Zip_Code__c,aa.ShippingPostalCode),
			             (CASE WHEN a.Zip_Code_4__c  IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' END),
			              COALESCE(a.Zip_Code_4__c, '' )) 
		END) ZipCode,
		(CASE WHEN ShippingCountry = 'CH' Then 'SWITZERLAND'Else a.Country_Picklist__c END) Country,
	    COALESCE(l.Tax__c,0) AS Tax
    
     
  FROM [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrders] o
INNER JOIN [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrderLine] l
         ON l.Order__c = o.id
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dr].[DimPuritanSalesforceAddress] a
         ON a.ID = o.Ship_To_Address__c
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dr].[DimPuritanSalesforceAccount] aa
		ON aa.id = o.Customer__c
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dr].[DimPuritanSalesforceItem] i
        on i.id = l.Product_Name__c
   WHERE 1 =1 
   AND o.Order_Status__c = 'Shipped/Complete'
   AND l.Item_Status__c = 'SHIPPED'
   AND o.Shipedge_Submitted__c='True'),
B AS(
SELECT 
 (CASE 
 WHEN len(trim(External_Key__c)) = 12 THEN
 SUBSTRING(External_Key__c, 1,len(trim(External_Key__c))-2)
 ELSE SUBSTRING(External_Key__c, 1,len(trim(External_Key__c))-3)
 END) Order_Number
,[Name] AS400_Order_Number
,''Shipedge_Order_Number
,[CreatedDate] as Shipped_Date
,[SKU_Number__c] as Item_Number
,''Item_Description
,([Quantity_Returned__c]-[Quantity_Returned__c])-[Quantity_Returned__c] as  Quantity_Shipped
,([Amount__c] - [Amount__c]) -[Amount__c]  as Final_Price
,''Customer_Number  
,''Ship_To_Address
,''City
,''State
,''Providence
,''ZipCode
,''Country
,([Tax_Amount__c]-[Tax_Amount__c])-[Tax_Amount__c] as Tax
  FROM [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrderAdjustmentLine] 
  where [Line_Item_Status__c] = 'SHIPPED'
  and Refund_Amount__c > 0),
C AS(
  SELECT 
  b.Order_Number,
  b.AS400_Order_Number,
  b.Shipedge_Order_Number,
  b.Shipped_Date,	
  b.Item_Number,	
  b.Item_Description,	
  b.Quantity_Shipped,	
  b.Final_Price,	
  a.Customer_Number,  
  a.Ship_To_Address,
  a.City,  
  a.State,
  a.Providence,
  a.ZipCode,
  a.Country,
  b.Tax

  FROM B b
  inner join A a on
  a.order_number = b.order_number
  where b.Order_Number IN (SELECT Order_Number FROM A)),
D AS(
  SELECT * FROM A
  UNION
  SELECT * FROM C)

  SELECT *
  ,current_timestamp LastUpdate
  FROM D;
