source.query:
WITH
sectmstp AS (SELECT MIN(SMHLFG) SMHLFG,
                    SMSECT
               FROM rsmfg.SECTMSTP
              GROUP BY SMSECT
              UNION ALL
             SELECT MIN(SMHLFG) SMHLFG,
                    SMSECT
               FROM prodfa.SECTMSTP
              GROUP BY SMSECT
              UNION ALL
             SELECT MIN(SMHLFG) SMHLFG,
                    SMSECT
               FROM slmfg.SECTMSTP
              GROUP BY SMSECT
              UNION ALL
             SELECT MIN(SMHLFG) SMHLFG,
                    SMSECT
               FROM camfg.SECTMSTP
              GROUP BY SMSECT),
BulkAndCompLocs AS (SELECT *
                      FROM prodfa.BLKLOCP
                     UNION ALL
                    SELECT *
                      FROM rsmfg.BLKLOCP
                     UNION ALL
                    SELECT *
                      FROM slmfg.BLKLOCP
                     UNION ALL
                    SELECT *
                      FROM camfg.BLKLOCP),
rawlocs AS (SELECT *
              FROM STARLEN.RWMTLCP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM softgels.RWMTLCP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM rsmfg.RWMTLCP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM slmfg.RWMTLCP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM camfg.RWMTLCP),
fginv AS (SELECT DIGITS(wrehs3) || '-' || DIGITS(rowloc) || '-' || skdloc || '-' || DIGITS(colloc) LOC,
                 WREHS3 WHS,
                 'FGINV' AREA,
                 lmsect SEC,
                 lmavl DEACT,
                 SMHLFG FLAG,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN LOC1 > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                           ELSE 'Wide'
                                                      END)
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN LOC1 BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                           ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                      END)
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN LOC1 BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                           ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                      END)
                       ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                  END) LOC2,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (3, 14, 22, 48) THEN 'NBTYMFG'
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (44, 45, 46, 47) THEN 'REXALL'
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (62, 63) THEN 'LEINER'
                       ELSE 'SOLGAR'
                  END) DCGROUP
            FROM prodfa.invlocp i
           INNER JOIN prodfa.locmst
                   ON wrehs3 = fgwhse
                  AND loc1 = rowloc
                  AND loc2 = skdloc
                  AND loc3 = colloc
           INNER JOIN sectmstp
                   ON SMSECT = LMSECT
           WHERE WREHS3 =47
             AND skdloc BETWEEN '01' AND '99'
             AND SUBSTR(lmsect, 1, 1) <> '#'
           GROUP BY DIGITS(wrehs3) || '-' || DIGITS(rowloc) || '-' || skdloc || '-' || DIGITS(colloc),
                    WREHS3,
                    lmsect,
                    lmavl,
                    SMHLFG,
                    (CASE
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN LOC1 > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                              ELSE 'Wide'
                                                         END)
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN LOC1 BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                              ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                         END)
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN LOC1 BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                              ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                         END)
                          ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                     END)),
cpinv AS (SELECT DIGITS(blwhse) || '-' || DIGITS(c.rowloc) || '-' || c.skdloc || '-' || DIGITS(c.colloc) LOC,
                 WREHS3 WHS,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN PART#P IN (11, 31, 32, 33) THEN 'BULK'
                       ELSE 'COMP'
                  END) AREA,
                 lmsect SEC,
                 lmavl DEACT,
                 SMHLFG Flag,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN l.ROWLOC > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                           ELSE 'Wide'
                                                      END)
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                           ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                      END)
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                           ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                      END)
                       ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                  END) LOC2,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (3, 14, 22, 48) THEN 'NBTYMFG'
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (44, 45, 46, 47) THEN 'REXALL'
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (62, 63) THEN 'LEINER'
                       ELSE 'SOLGAR'
                  END) DCGROUP
            FROM BulkAndCompLocs c
           INNER JOIN prodfa.locmst l
                   ON wrehs3 = blwhse
                  AND l.rowloc = c.rowloc
                  AND l.skdloc = c.skdloc
                  AND l.colloc = c.colloc
           INNER JOIN sectmstp
                   ON SMSECT = l.LMSECT
           WHERE WREHS3 = 47
             AND l.skdloc BETWEEN '01' AND '99'
             AND SUBSTR(l.lmsect, 1, 1) <> '#'
             AND l.LMSECT <> ''
           GROUP BY DIGITS(blwhse) || '-' || DIGITS(c.rowloc) || '-' || c.skdloc || '-' || DIGITS(c.colloc),
                    WREHS3,
                    (CASE
                          WHEN PART#P IN (11, 31, 32, 33) THEN 'BULK'
                          ELSE 'COMP'
                     END),
                    lmsect,
                    lmavl,
                    SMHLFG,
                    (CASE
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN l.ROWLOC > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                              ELSE 'Wide'
                                                         END)
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                              ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                         END)
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                              ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                         END)
                          ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                     END)),
rawinv AS (SELECT DIGITS(rmwhse) || '-' || DIGITS(r.rmlrow) || '-' || r.rmlskd || '-' || DIGITS(r.rmlclm) LOC,
                  WREHS3 WHS,
                  'RAW' AREA,
                  lmsect SEC,
                  lmavl DEACT,
                  SMHLFG FLAG,
                  (CASE
                        WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                            WHEN l.ROWLOC > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                            ELSE 'Wide'
                                                       END)
                        WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                            WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                            ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                       END)
                        WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                            WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                            ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                       END)
                        ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                   END) LOC2,
                  (CASE
                        WHEN wrehs3 IN (3, 14, 22, 48) THEN 'NBTYMFG'
                        WHEN wrehs3 IN (44, 45, 46, 47) THEN 'REXALL'
                        WHEN wrehs3 IN (62, 63) THEN 'LEINER'
                        ELSE 'SOLGAR'
                   END) DCGROUP
             FROM rawLocs r
            INNER JOIN prodfa.locmst l
                    ON wrehs3 = rmwhse
                   AND l.rowloc = r.rmlrow
                   AND l.skdloc = r.rmlskd
                   AND l.colloc = r.rmlclm
            INNER JOIN sectmstp
                    ON SMSECT = l.LMSECT
            WHERE WREHS3 = 47
              AND r.rmlskd BETWEEN '01' AND '99'
              AND SUBSTR(l.lmsect, 1, 1) <> '#'
              AND l.LMSECT <> ''
            GROUP BY DIGITS(rmwhse) || '-' || DIGITS(r.rmlrow) || '-' || r.rmlskd || '-' || DIGITS(r.rmlclm),
                     WREHS3,
                     lmsect,
                     lmavl,
                     SMHLFG,
                     (CASE
                           WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                               WHEN l.ROWLOC > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                               ELSE 'Wide'
                                                          END)
                           WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                               WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                               ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                          END)
                           WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                               WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                               ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                          END)
                           ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                      END)),
Allinv AS (SELECT *
             FROM fginv
            UNION ALL
           SELECT *
             FROM cpinv
            UNION ALL
           SELECT *
             FROM rawinv),
DCTOTALS AS (SELECT WHS AS WHS,
                    DCGROUP AS Group,
                    COUNT(WHS) ALLDCTOTALUSED,
                    CASE
                         WHEN FLAG = 'H' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END ALLDCUSEDLHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN FLAG = 'L' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END ALLDCUSEDLLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END ALLDCUSEDNARROW,
                    CASE
                         WHEN LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END ALLDCUSEDWIDE,
                    CASE
                         WHEN FLAG = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END ALLDCUSEDNARROWHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN FLAG = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END ALLDCUSEDNARROWLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN FLAG = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END ALLDCUSEDWIDEHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN FLAG = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END ALLDCUSEDWIDELO,
                    COUNT(WHS) AS UsedLocs,
                    CASE
                         WHEN LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWUSED,
                    CASE
                         WHEN LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDEUSED,
                    CASE
                         WHEN Flag = 'H' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS USEDHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN Flag = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWUSEDHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN Flag = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDEUSEDHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN Flag = 'L' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS USEDLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN Flag = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWUSEDLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN Flag = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDEUSEDLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'COMP' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS TOTALCOMP,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'COMP'
                          AND FLAG = 'H' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS COMPHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'COMP'
                          AND FLAG = 'L' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS COMPLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'COMP'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWCOMP,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'COMP'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDECOMP,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'COMP'
                          AND FLAG = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWCOMPHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'COMP'
                          AND FLAG = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWCOMPLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'COMP'
                          AND FLAG = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDECOMPHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'COMP'
                          AND FLAG = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDECOMPLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'RAW' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS TOTALRAW,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'RAW'
                          AND FLAG = 'H' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS RAWHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'RAW'
                          AND FLAG = 'L' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS RAWLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'RAW'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWRAW,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'RAW'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDERAW,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'RAW'
                          AND FLAG = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWRAWHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'RAW'
                          AND FLAG = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWRAWLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'RAW'
                          AND FLAG = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDERAWHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'RAW'
                          AND FLAG = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDERAWLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'FGINV' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS TOTALFG,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'FGINV'
                          AND FLAG = 'H' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS FGINVHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'FGINV'
                          AND FLAG = 'L' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS FGINVLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'FGINV'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWFGINV,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'FGINV'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDEFGINV,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'FGINV'
                          AND FLAG = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWFGINVHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'FGINV'
                          AND FLAG = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWFGINVLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'FGINV'
                          AND FLAG = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDEFGINVHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'FGINV'
                          AND FLAG = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDEFGINVLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'BULK' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS TOTALBULK,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'BULK'
                          AND FLAG = 'H' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS BULKHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'BULK'
                          AND FLAG = 'L' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS BULKLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'BULK'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWBULK,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'BULK'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDEBULK,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'BULK'
                          AND FLAG = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWBULKHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'BULK'
                          AND FLAG = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Narrow' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS NARROWBULKLO,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'BULK'
                          AND FLAG = 'H'
                          AND LOC2 = 'Wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDEBULKHI,
                    CASE
                         WHEN AREA = 'BULK'
                          AND FLAG = 'L'
                          AND LOC2 = 'wide' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END AS WIDEBULKLO
               FROM Allinv
              GROUP BY DCGROUP,
                       WHS,
                       FLAG,
                       LOC2,
                       AREA)
SELECT WHS,
 CASE WHEN GROUP = 'NBTYMFG' THEN 1
WHEN Group = 'REXALL' THEN 2
WHEN Group = 'SOLGAR' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END GROUP,
       SUM(ALLDCTOTALUSED) ALLDCUSED,
       SUM(ALLDCUSEDLHI) ALLDCHI,
       SUM(ALLDCUSEDLLO) ALLDCLO,
       SUM(ALLDCUSEDNARROW) ALLDCNARROW,
       SUM(ALLDCUSEDWIDE) ALLDCWIDE,
       SUM(ALLDCUSEDNARROWHI) ALLDCNARROWHI,
       SUM(ALLDCUSEDNARROWLO) ALLDCNARROWLO,
       SUM(ALLDCUSEDWIDEHI) ALLDCWIDEHI,
       SUM(ALLDCUSEDWIDELO) ALLDCWIDELO,
       SUM(UsedLocs) AS USEDLOCS,
       SUM(NARROWUSED) AS NARROWUSED,
       SUM(WIDEUSED) AS WIDEUSED,
       SUM(USEDHI) AS USEDHI,
       SUM(NARROWUSEDHI) AS NARROWUSEDHI,
       SUM(WIDEUSEDHI) AS WIDEUSEDHI,
       SUM(USEDLO) AS USEDLO,
       SUM(NARROWUSEDLO) AS NARROWUSEDLO,
       SUM(WIDEUSEDLO) AS WIDEUSEDLO,

                        SUBSTR(bhpst, 1, 1) TRANSTYPECOD,
                        MAX(bdclas) BOLFAKCLASS,
                        SUM(bdwt) WEIGHT,
                        (CASE

                                      FROM nbjdta.bldet
                                     WHERE (LOCATE('TEMP', bdtxt) > 0 OR
                                            LOCATE('DEGREE', bdtxt) > 0 OR
                                            LOCATE('REEFER', bdtxt) > 0)
                                       AND bdbl# = bhbl#) IS NOT NULL OR
                                   SUBSTR(BHPST, 2, 1) = 'R' THEN 'Reefer'
                              ELSE 'Dry'
                         END) TRANSMODE,
                        (CASE
                              WHEN SUBSTR(BHPST, 1, 1) = 'L' THEN 'LTL'
                              WHEN SUBSTR(BHPST, 1, 1) = 'F' THEN 'FTL'
                              WHEN SUBSTR(BHPST, 1, 1) = 'I' THEN 'IMC'
                              WHEN TRIM(BHCRR) IN ('PC', 'HU') THEN 'IMC'
                              WHEN BHSEAL <> '' THEN 'FTL'
                              ELSE 'LTL'
                         END) TRANSTYPE,
                        (CASE
                              WHEN bhnonecnt <> '' THEN bhnonecnt
                              ELSE (CASE
                                         WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ppltid)
                                                 FROM nbjdta.artpltpf,
                                                      nbjdta.artordpf
                                                WHERE obolnum = bhbl#
                                                  AND oorddiv = porddiv
                                                  AND oordnum = pordnum
                                                  AND oordbos = pordbos) > 0 THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ppltid)
                                                                                     FROM nbjdta.artpltpf,
                                                                                          nbjdta.artordpf
                                                                                    WHERE obolnum = bhbl#
                                                                                      AND oorddiv = porddiv
                                                                                      AND oordnum = pordnum
                                                                                      AND oordbos = pordbos)

                                                                                                 WHERE bdbl# = bhbl#
                                                                                                   AND BDUOM = 'PLT'), 0)

	  FROM [dr].[calendar]
	  JOIN [dr].[Shipping_Days] ON [Shipping_Days].[Date]=[calendar].[Date]

  UPDATE C SET C.[Prior_Shipping_Date]=SUB.prior_day
  FROM [dr].[calendar] C
	JOIN (SELECT [Date]
		  ,(SELECT MAX(S.[DATE]) FROM [dr].[calendar] S WHERE S.[Shipping_Day]='Y' AND S.[DATE]<O.[DATE]) prior_day
	  FROM [dr].[calendar] O
	  where [Shipping_Day] is not null AND [Prior_Shipping_Date] IS NULL
	) SUB
	  ON C.[DATE]=SUB.[DATE]

,AUX_DATES.MANUFACTURING_SITE 
,AUX_DATES.PACKAGING_SITE 
,AUX_DATES.FORMULA_REVISION 
,AUX_DATES.LABEL_REVISION 
,CASE AUX_DATES.AFFECTED_ITEM_TYPE --Smitha 
       WHEN 'Finished Goods' THEN NULL 
    ELSE AUX_DATES.BULK_TYPE 
     END BULK_TYPE 
,AUX_LOT_COUNT.LOT_COUNT 
,AUX_DATES.UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNUMBER--Ezhil 
,AUX_DATES.UNIDENTIFIED_BULKNUMBER--Ezhil 
,AUX_DATES.UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME--Ezhil 
,AUX_DATES.UNIDENTIFIED_TIMESTAMP--Ezhil 
,SYSDATE REPORT_RUN_TIME 
FROM 
(  
  SELECT DISTINCT 
   TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(AUX.ORIG_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), 'GMT') AT TIME ZONE '-05:00', 'MM/DD/YYYY') ORIG_DATE 
   ,TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(AUX.ORIG_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), 'GMT') AT TIME ZONE '-05:00', 'MM/YYYY') AUX_ORIG_DATE 
   ,TO_CHAR(AUX.AUX_DATE, 'MM/YYYY') AUX_DATE 
   ,AUX.COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
   ,AUX.COMPLAINT_TYPE 
   ,AUX.CATEGORY_NAME 
   ,AUX.SUBCATEGORY_NAME 
   ,AUX.COMPLAINT_DESCRIPTION 
   ,AUX.REPORTER_NAME 
   ,AUX.REPORTER_COUNTRY 
   ,AUX.CONSUMER_NAME 
   ,AUX.CONSUMER_COUNTRY 
   ,AUX.POINT_OF_PURCHASE  --New attribute Rajesh 
   ,AUX.BRAND 
   ,AUX.SERIOUS_ADVERSE 
   ,AUX.INTERNATIONAL_COMPLAINT 
   ,AUX.UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCT 
   ,AUX.UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCT_DESC 
   ,AUX.ASSOCIATED_CASE_NUMBER 
   ,AUX.CINV_NUMBER 
   ,AUX.EQUIPMENT_TRENDS 
   ,AUX.AER_NUMBER 
   ,AUX.ASSESSMENT 
   ,AUX.CUSTOMER_RESPONSE_REQUIRED 
   ,AUX.INVESTIGATION_REQUESTED 
   ,AUX.SALESFORCE_CASE_CREATION_USER --Ezhil 
   ,AUX.SALESFORCE_CASE_CREATION_DATE --Ezhil 
   ,AUX.SALESFORCE_CASE_LAST_UPDATED_USER --Ezhil 
   ,AUX.SALESFORCE_CASE_LAST_UPDATED_DATE --Ezhil 
   ,AUX.AFFECTED_ITEM_NUMBER 
   ,AUX.AFFECTED_ITEM_TYPE 
   ,AUX.AFFECTED_ITEM_DESCRIPTION 
   ,AUX.AS400_NUMBER 
   ,AUX.LOT_NUMBER 
   ,AUX.BULK_NUMBER 
   ,AUX.MANUFACTURING_SITE 
   ,AUX.PACKAGING_SITE 
   ,AUX.FORMULA_REVISION 
   ,AUX.LABEL_REVISION 
   ,AUX.BULK_TYPE 
   ,AUX.UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNUMBER--Ezhil 
   ,AUX.UNIDENTIFIED_BULKNUMBER--Ezhil 
   ,AUX.UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME--Ezhil 
   ,AUX.UNIDENTIFIED_TIMESTAMP				  --Ezhil 
   FROM  
   ( 
     SELECT DISTINCT 
      NVL(AGILE_DATE.FLEXDATE, PSR.ORIG_DATE) ORIG_DATE 
     ,PSR.PSR_NO COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
     ,LISTENTRY.ENTRYVALUE COMPLAINT_TYPE 
     ,VW_COMPLAINT_CATEGORY.CATEGORY_NAME 
     ,VW_COMPLAINT_SUBCATEGORY.SUBCATEGORY_NAME 
     ,PSR.DESCRIPTION COMPLAINT_DESCRIPTION 
                                      ,PAGE_THREE.TEXT32 REPORTER_NAME 
                                       ,LISTENTRY_REPORTER_COUNTRY.ENTRYVALUE REPORTER_COUNTRY--PAGE_THREE.list36 REPORTER_COUNTRY--LISTENTRY.entryid -- nvl(LISTENTRY.DESCRIPTION,LISTENTRY.entryvalue)  
          ,PAGE_THREE.TEXT40 CONSUMER_NAME 
 ,PAGE_THREE.TEXT47 POINT_OF_PURCHASE  --New Attribute Rajesh 
           ,LISTENTRY_CONSUMER_COUNTRY.ENTRYVALUE CONSUMER_COUNTRY 
     ,LISTENTRY_BRAND.ENTRYVALUE BRAND 
     ,LISTENTRY_SERIOUS_ADVERSE.ENTRYVALUE SERIOUS_ADVERSE 
     ,LISTENTRY_INTERNATIONAL.ENTRYVALUE INTERNATIONAL_COMPLAINT 
     ,FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED.TEXT UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCT 
     ,FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_DESCRIPTION.TEXT UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCT_DESC 
     ,PAGE_THREE.TEXT31 ASSOCIATED_CASE_NUMBER 
                                        ,AUX_CINV.CINV_NUMBER 
     ,AUX_CINV.EQUIPMENT_TRENDS 
                                        ,AUX_AER.AER_NUMBER 
     ,AUX_AER.ASSESSMENT 
                                        ,CASE 
      WHEN PAGE_THREE.LIST55 = 1 THEN 'Yes'

      WHEN INVESTIGATION_REQUESTED.NUMBER1 = 0 THEN 'N/A'

     ,ITEM.ITEM_NUMBER AFFECTED_ITEM_NUMBER

     ,PAGE_TWO.TEXT11 AS400_NUMBER

     ,PSR_ITEM.TEXT04 LABEL_REVISION

 ,PSR_ITEM.TEXT05 UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNUMBER --Ezhil 
 ,PSR_ITEM.TEXT07 UNIDENTIFIED_BULKNUMBER --Ezhil 
 ,FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME.TEXT UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME --Ezhil 
 ,PSR_ITEM.TEXT08 UNIDENTIFIED_TIMESTAMP --Ezhil 
     ,ADD_MONTHS(FROM_TZ(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), 'GMT') AT TIME ZONE '-05:00', -1) AUX_DATE 
    FROM 
     AGILE.PSR 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PAGE_THREE 
     ON PSR.ID = PAGE_THREE.ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY 
     ON PAGE_THREE.LIST31 = LISTENTRY.ENTRYID 
       -- LEFT OUTER JOIN (select listentry.entryvalue value, listentry.entryid from AGILE.LISTENTRY) LISTENTRY2 
     --ON LISTENTRY.ENTRYID = PAGE_THREE.LIST36  
          --ON PAGE_THREE.LIST36 = LISTENTRY2.ENTRYID   
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.VW_COMPLAINT_CATEGORY 
     ON PSR.ID = VW_COMPLAINT_CATEGORY.COMPLAINT_ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.VW_COMPLAINT_SUBCATEGORY 
     ON PSR.ID = VW_COMPLAINT_SUBCATEGORY.COMPLAINT_ID 
     AND SUBSTR(VW_COMPLAINT_CATEGORY.CATEGORY_NAME, INSTR(VW_COMPLAINT_CATEGORY.CATEGORY_NAME, '|') + 1) = REPLACE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(VW_COMPLAINT_SUBCATEGORY.SUBCATEGORY_NAME, '|[^|]+|'), '|') 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_REPORTER_COUNTRY --MANINI

          AND LISTENTRY_REPORTER_COUNTRY.PARENTID = 365 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_CONSUMER_COUNTRY --SMITHA

          AND LISTENTRY_CONSUMER_COUNTRY.PARENTID = 365 
        LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_BRAND

-- Updated Start 
LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_SALESFORCE_CREATE_USER 
ON PSR.ID = FLEX_SALESFORCE_CREATE_USER.ID 
AND FLEX_SALESFORCE_CREATE_USER.ATTID = 2472768

ON PSR.ID = FLEX_SALESFORCE_CREATE_DATE.ID

--Updated End 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_INTERNATIONAL 
     ON FLEX_INTERNATIONAL.NUMBER1 = LISTENTRY_INTERNATIONAL.ENTRYID 
     AND LISTENTRY_INTERNATIONAL.PARENTID = 2000003226 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PSR_ITEM 
     ON PSR.ID = PSR_ITEM.PSR_ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.ITEM 
     ON PSR_ITEM.ITEM_ID = ITEM.ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PAGE_TWO 
     ON PSR_ITEM.ITEM_ID = PAGE_TWO.ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.NODETABLE 
     ON ITEM.SUBCLASS = NODETABLE.ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED 
     ON PSR.ID = FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED.ID 
     AND FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED.ATTID = 2472766 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_DESCRIPTION 
     ON PSR.ID = FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_DESCRIPTION.ID 
     AND FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_DESCRIPTION.ATTID = 2472767 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_MFG_SITE 
     ON PSR_ITEM.LIST01 = LISTENTRY_MFG_SITE.ENTRYID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_PKG_SITE 
     ON PSR_ITEM.LIST02 = LISTENTRY_PKG_SITE.ENTRYID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX AGILE_DATE 
     ON PSR.ID = AGILE_DATE.ID 
     AND AGILE_DATE.ATTID = 2472650 
 LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME 
 ON PSR.ID=FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME.ID 
 AND FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME.ATTID=2000009197  
     and psr_item.id=FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME.row_id--Chandana P 
        LEFT OUTER JOIN 
      ( 
      SELECT DISTINCT 
         PSR.ID COMPLAINT_ID 
         ,QCR.QCR_NUMBER CINV_NUMBER 
         ,AGILE_FLEX.TEXT EQUIPMENT_TRENDS 
       FROM 
         AGILE.PSR 
       INNER JOIN AGILE.RELATIONSHIP 
         ON PSR.ID = RELATIONSHIP.EFF_OBJID 
         AND PSR.PSR_NO LIKE 'CPC%' 
       INNER JOIN AGILE.QCR 
         ON RELATIONSHIP.CTR_OBJID = QCR.ID 
         AND QCR.QCR_NUMBER LIKE 'CINV%' 
       LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX 
         ON QCR.ID = AGILE_FLEX.ID 
         AND AGILE_FLEX.ATTID = 2472808 
      ) AUX_CINV 
                                         ON PSR.ID = AUX_CINV.COMPLAINT_ID 
          LEFT OUTER JOIN 
      ( 
       SELECT DISTINCT 
         PSR.ID COMPLAINT_ID 
         ,QCR.QCR_NUMBER AER_NUMBER 
                ,(select text33 from agile.page_three where page_three.id = qcr.id ) ASSESSMENT 
                --,(select text32 from agile.page_three where page_three.id = psr.id ) REPORTER_NAME 
       FROM 
         AGILE.PSR 
       INNER JOIN AGILE.RELATIONSHIP 
         ON PSR.ID = RELATIONSHIP.EFF_OBJID 
         AND PSR.PSR_NO LIKE 'CPC%' 
       INNER JOIN AGILE.QCR 
         ON RELATIONSHIP.CTR_OBJID = QCR.ID 
         AND QCR.QCR_NUMBER LIKE 'AER%' 
       LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX 
         ON QCR.ID = AGILE_FLEX.ID 
         AND AGILE_FLEX.ATTID = '2472808' 
      ) AUX_AER 
     ON PSR.ID = AUX_AER.COMPLAINT_ID 
          AND AUX_AER.COMPLAINT_ID = AUX_CINV.COMPLAINT_ID 
           --Manini                      
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PAGE_THREE ITEM_PAGE_THREE 
     ON ITEM_PAGE_THREE.ID = ITEM.ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY BULK_TYPE_LISTENTRY 
     ON BULK_TYPE_LISTENTRY.ENTRYID = ITEM_PAGE_THREE.LIST31 
    WHERE 
     PSR.PSR_NO LIKE 'CPC%'  
   ) AUX 
) AUX_DATES 
LEFT OUTER JOIN 
  ( 
   SELECT DISTINCT 
    AUX.COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
    ,AUX.ITEM_NUMBER 
    ,AUX.ITEM_TYPE 
    ,AUX.LOT_NUMBER 
    ,CASE 
        WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'BULK' THEN 1 
        WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'DISTRIBUTION UNIT' THEN 1 --Smitha - TSK200840 
    WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'FINISHED GOODS' AND (INSTR(UPPER(AUX_COL), 'BULK')) > 0 THEN 2 --modified from Finished Goods  Smitha 
    WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'FINISHED GOODS' AND (INSTR(UPPER(AUX_COL), 'BULK')) = 0 THEN 1 --modified from Finished Goods  Smitha 
        WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'DISTRIBUTION UNIT' AND (INSTR(UPPER(AUX_COL), 'BULK')) > 0 THEN 2 --Smitha - TSK200840 
        WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'DISTRIBUTION UNIT' AND (INSTR(UPPER(AUX_COL), 'BULK')) = 0 THEN 1 --Smitha - TSK200840 
    END LOT_COUNT 
   FROM 
    (  
     SELECT 
      PSR.PSR_NO COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
      ,ITEM.ITEM_NUMBER 
      ,PSR_ITEM.TEXT01 LOT_NUMBER 
      ,NODETABLE.DESCRIPTION ITEM_TYPE 
     FROM 
      AGILE.PSR 
     LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PSR_ITEM 
      ON PSR.ID = PSR_ITEM.PSR_ID 
     LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.ITEM 
      ON PSR_ITEM.ITEM_ID = ITEM.ID 
     LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.NODETABLE 
      ON ITEM.SUBCLASS = NODETABLE.ID 
     WHERE 
      PSR.PSR_NO LIKE 'CPC%' 
    ) AUX   
   INNER JOIN 
     ( 
      SELECT DISTINCT 
       PSR.PSR_NO COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
       ,PSR_ITEM.TEXT01 LOT_NUMBER 
       ,LISTAGG(NODETABLE.DESCRIPTION, ';') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY NODETABLE.DESCRIPTION) AS AUX_COL 
      FROM 
       AGILE.PSR 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PSR_ITEM 
       ON PSR.ID = PSR_ITEM.PSR_ID 
            LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PSR_ITEM 
       ON PSR.ID = PSR_ITEM.PSR_ID 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.ITEM 
       ON PSR_ITEM.ITEM_ID = ITEM.ID 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.NODETABLE 
       ON ITEM.SUBCLASS = NODETABLE.ID 
      WHERE 
       PSR.PSR_NO LIKE 'CPC%' 
      GROUP BY 
       PSR.PSR_NO 
       ,PSR_ITEM.TEXT01 
     ) AUX2 
    ON AUX.COMPLAINT_NUMBER = AUX2.COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
    AND AUX.LOT_NUMBER = AUX2.LOT_NUMBER 
  ) AUX_LOT_COUNT 
ON AUX_DATES.COMPLAINT_NUMBER = AUX_LOT_COUNT.COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
AND AUX_DATES.AFFECTED_ITEM_NUMBER = AUX_LOT_COUNT.ITEM_NUMBER 
AND AUX_DATES.LOT_NUMBER = AUX_LOT_COUNT.LOT_NUMBER 
WHERE 
AUX_DATES.AUX_ORIG_DATE = AUX_DATES.AUX_DATE 
ORDER BY 
AUX_DATES.ORIG_DATE 
,AUX_DATES.COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
,AUX_DATES.AFFECTED_ITEM_NUMBER 
,AUX_LOT_COUNT.LOT_COUNT

SELECT *
  FROM prodfa.blqrlshl
 WHERE 1 = 1

   AND hasts = 'X'
   AND hbsts = 'Q'
   ORDER BY hnblot

--STARLEN, SOFTGELS, SLMFG, RSMFG, TXMFG, ECMFG.    
WITH
STARLEN AS (SELECT ebxnf2,
                   ebxitm,
                   a.rmrm#,
                   a.rmnlt#,
                   a.rmvlt#,
                   a.rmqctr,
                   a.rmqctr,
                   a.rmqty,
                   a.rmwhse,
                   whsf03,
                   a.rmstat,
                   CASE
                        WHEN a.rmexp = 0 THEN 0
                        ELSE a.rmexp + 2800
                   END AS ExpDte,
                   a.rmcde,
                   (SELECT INT(NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD'))
                      FROM STARLEN.RMHSTP pa
                     WHERE a.RMCDE = pa.RMCDE
                       AND a.RMNLT# = pa.RMNLT#
                    FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) Date1,
                   'STARLEN' AREA,
                   hcomm,
                   (CASE
                         WHEN HCOMM LIKE '%OOS%' THEN 1
                         ELSE 0
                    END) OOS,
                   INT(NBTYGPL.idate(qr.RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD')) Quality_Released_Date
              FROM STARLEN.rwmtlcp a
              LEFT OUTER JOIN prodfa.oebsxrpf b
                           ON a.RMRM# = b.EBXNBR
                          AND ebxtyp = 'RM'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN prodfa.whsmstp c
                           ON a.RMWHSE = c.WHSNBR
              LEFT OUTER JOIN starlen.rmqrlshl2 hc
                           ON hc.HRM = a.RMRM#
                          AND hc.HNLT# = a.RMNLT#
                          AND hc.hasts = 'X'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN starlen.rmhstp qr
                           ON a.RMRM# = qr.RMRM#
                          AND a.rmnlt# = qr.RMNLT#
                          AND qr.RMFL11 = 'RMQ140'
             WHERE a.rmqty > 0),

                    ebxitm,

                    a.rmvlt#,
                    a.rmqctr,
                    a.rmqctr,

               LEFT OUTER JOIN prodfa.whsmstp c

            FROM SLMFG.rwmtlcp a
            LEFT OUTER JOIN prodfa.oebsxrpf b

                        AND ebxtyp = 'RM'
            LEFT OUTER JOIN prodfa.whsmstp c
                         ON a.RMWHSE = c.WHSNBR
            LEFT OUTER JOIN starlen.rmqrlshl2 hc
                         ON hc.HRM = a.RMRM#

            LEFT OUTER JOIN starlen.rmhstp qr

                 'TXMFG' AREA,
                 hcomm,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN HCOMM LIKE '%OOS%' THEN 1
                       ELSE 0
                  END) OOS,
                 INT(NBTYGPL.idate(qr.RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD')) Quality_Released_Date
            FROM TXMFG.rwmtlcp a
            LEFT OUTER JOIN prodfa.oebsxrpf b
                         ON a.RMRM# = b.EBXNBR
                        AND ebxtyp = 'RM'
            LEFT OUTER JOIN prodfa.whsmstp c
                         ON a.RMWHSE = c.WHSNBR
            LEFT OUTER JOIN starlen.rmqrlshl2 hc
                         ON hc.HRM = a.RMRM#
                        AND hc.HNLT# = a.RMNLT#
                        AND hc.hasts = 'X'
            LEFT OUTER JOIN starlen.rmhstp qr
                         ON a.RMRM# = qr.RMRM#
                        AND a.rmnlt# = qr.RMNLT#
                        AND qr.RMFL11 = 'RMQ140'
           WHERE a.rmqty > 0),
ECMFG AS (SELECT ebxnf2,
                 ebxitm,
                 a.rmrm#,
                 a.rmnlt#,
                 a.rmvlt#,
                 a.rmqctr,
                 a.rmqctr,
                 a.rmqty,
                 a.rmwhse,
                 whsf03,
                 a.rmstat,
                 CASE
                      WHEN a.rmexp = 0 THEN 0
                      ELSE a.rmexp + 2800
                 END AS ExpDte,
                 a.rmcde,
                 (SELECT INT(NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD'))
                    FROM ECMFG.RMHSTP pa
                   WHERE a.RMCDE = pa.RMCDE
                     AND a.RMNLT# = pa.RMNLT#
                  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) Date1,
                 'ECMFG' AREA,
                 hcomm,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN HCOMM LIKE '%OOS%' THEN 1
                       ELSE 0
                  END) OOS,
                 INT(NBTYGPL.idate(qr.RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD')) Quality_Released_Date
            FROM ECMFG.rwmtlcp a
            LEFT OUTER JOIN prodfa.oebsxrpf b
                         ON a.RMRM# = b.EBXNBR
                        AND ebxtyp = 'RM'
            LEFT OUTER JOIN prodfa.whsmstp c
                         ON a.RMWHSE = c.WHSNBR
            LEFT OUTER JOIN starlen.rmqrlshl2 hc
                         ON hc.HRM = a.RMRM#
                        AND hc.HNLT# = a.RMNLT#
                        AND hc.hasts = 'X'
            LEFT OUTER JOIN starlen.rmhstp qr
                         ON a.RMRM# = qr.RMRM#
                        AND a.rmnlt# = qr.RMNLT#
                        AND qr.RMFL11 = 'RMQ140'
           WHERE a.rmqty > 0),
ALLDATA AS (SELECT *
              FROM STARLEN
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM SOFTGELS
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM SLMFG
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM RSMFG
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM TXMFG
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM ECMFG)
SELECT Distinct ad.*,
       CURRENT_DATE RunDate
  FROM ALLDATA ad

SELECT *
  FROM prodfa.smptrkBKpf blk

SELECT *
  FROM prodfa.smptrkrmpf raw

activities.name: IntegratedOrders_SCDType2
activities.description: This script will check all active records and will disable them if there is a newer record available. This way we can have history of how the records are changing over time but will only have the latest as active.

scripts.text:
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#F_Table_Dates') IS NOT NULL
DROP TABLE #F_Table_Dates 

select * 

into #F_Table_Dates

from (
		 select 
				 OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID
				,OrderLINeItemNumber
				,Start_Date
				,End_Date
				,lead(Start_Date,1) over (
											partition by OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID,OrderLINeItemNumber order by convert(date,Start_Date)) as next_start 

		FROM
				[dr].[IntegratedOrders_ext]

				) sub where next_start is not null AND End_Date <> dateadd(second,-1,next_start) AND convert(date,End_Date) = convert(date,'9999-12-31')


IF EXISTS (
	SELECT 1
	FROM #F_Table_Dates b 
)
			BEGIN
				
				UPDATE [dr].[IntegratedOrders_ext]
				set End_Date = dateadd(second,-1,b.next_start)
				from #F_Table_Dates b
				where	b.OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID = [IntegratedOrders_ext].OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID AND
						b.OrderLINeItemNumber =[IntegratedOrders_ext].OrderLINeItemNumber
						
					and [IntegratedOrders_ext].Start_Date = b.Start_Date
					and b.End_Date <> dateadd(second,-1,b.next_start)
					and convert(date,b.End_Date) = convert(date,'9999-12-31')
					AND CONVERT(DATE,[IntegratedOrders_ext].End_Date) = convert(date,'9999-12-31')

			END

Truncate Table dr.dimCombinedMaterialHierarchy;

 WITH ORGAIN_ITEMS AS (
     
	 SELECT 
			 [DATE]
			,[FG_Num]
			,[Item_Description]
			,convert(NVARCHAR,GTIN) as GTIN
	 FROM 
			[dr].[Orgain_Data] 
	WHERE 
				FG_Num IS NOT NULL
			AND [Reporting_Country] IN ('USA','0')
			AND [DATE] > (SELECT MAX([Invoice_Date]) ACTUALS_MAX_DATE FROM [dr].[Orgain_YTD_Actuals] WHERE [Reporting_Country] IN ('USA','0') AND [Type] IN ('INVOICE','CREDIT MEMO'))
			AND [Document_Type] in ('Invoice','Credit Memo') 

	UNION
	
	SELECT 
			 [INVOICE_DATE] "DATE"
			,[FG_Num]
			,[Item_Description]
			,GTIN

	FROM
			[dr].[Orgain_YTD_Actuals]
	WHERE
				FG_Num IS NOT NULL
			AND [Reporting_Country] IN ('USA','0')
			AND [Type] IN ('INVOICE','CREDIT MEMO')
),


Combined_Items AS (
      SELECT
        TRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR,[Product_Number])) as MaterialKey,
        TRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR,[Product_Number])) as MaterialID,
        [Product_Description] as MaterialDesc,
        --[Item_Number] as EANUPC,
               UPC EANUPC,
		Null as MaterialType,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketID,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessID,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel3CategoryID,
		'US ' + UPPER([Item_Brand]) as ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel4SubcategoryID,
		'US ' + UPPER([Item_Brand]) ProductLevel4SubcategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentID,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentDescription,
		Null as Division,
		Null as Subdivision,
		Null as OPCO,
		Null as Company_Code,
		Null as Salesorg,
		Null as Distr_Chan,
		Null as CrossPlantMaterialStatus,
		Null as CorporateBrandCode,
		[Item_Brand] as CorporateBrandDescription,
		Null as RangeBrandCode,
		Null as RangeBrandDescription,
		Null as DenominationBrandCode,
		Null as DenominationBrandDescription,
		Null as AnimalFarm,
		'Other' as PL3NHSSales,
        1 as rn
   FROM [dr].[Atrium_dim_product_DS]

	UNION ALL

	    SELECT 
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR,[FG_Num]) as MaterialKey,
        [FG_Num] as MaterialID,
        [Item_Description] as MaterialDesc,
        GTIN as EANUPC,
		Null as MaterialType,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketID,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessID,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel3CategoryID,
		'US Orgain' as ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel4SubcategoryID,
		'US Orgain' ProductLevel4SubcategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentID,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentDescription,
		Null as Division,
		Null as Subdivision,
		Null as OPCO,
		Null as Company_Code,
		Null as Salesorg,
		Null as Distr_Chan,
		Null as CrossPlantMaterialStatus,
		Null as CorporateBrandCode,
		'Orgain' as CorporateBrandDescription,
		Null as RangeBrandCode,
		Null as RangeBrandDescription,
		Null as DenominationBrandCode,
		Null as DenominationBrandDescription,
		Null as AnimalFarm,
		'Other' as PL3NHSSales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [FG_Num] ORDER BY [Item_Description] DESC, [DATE] DESC) AS rn
    FROM ORGAIN_ITEMS

	UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR,[ITEM]) as MaterialKey,
        [ITEM] as MaterialID,
        [ITEM_DESCRIPTION] as MaterialDesc,
        [UPC] as EANUPC,
		Null as MaterialType,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketID,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessID,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel3CategoryID,
		'US ' + UPPER(BRAND) as ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel4SubcategoryID,
		'US ' + UPPER([Brand]) + ' ' + [UNIT_OF_MEASURE] ProductLevel4SubcategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentID,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentDescription,
		Null as Division,
		Null as Subdivision,
		Null as OPCO,
		Null as Company_Code,
		Null as Salesorg,
		Null as Distr_Chan,
		Null as CrossPlantMaterialStatus,
		Null as CorporateBrandCode,
		BRAND as CorporateBrandDescription,
		Null as RangeBrandCode,
		Null as RangeBrandDescription,
		Null as DenominationBrandCode,
		Null as DenominationBrandDescription,
		Null as AnimalFarm,
		'Other' as PL3NHSSales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ITEM] ORDER BY ordered_Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM [dr].[GOL_SKU_Revenue]
	WHERE
		--690 – Employee Expense
		--691 – Friends and Family
		--514,052,050,512 International Cost Centers
		[SALESREP_CC] NOT IN ('514', '052', '050', '512','690','691')
	AND BRAND IS NOT NULL

	UNION ALL

	SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR,N1.MaterialKey) AS MaterialKey,
		N1.MaterialID,
		N1.MaterialDesc,
		N1.EANUPC,
		N1.MaterialType,
		N1.ProductLevel1MarketID,
		N1.ProductLevel1MarketDescription,
		N1.ProductLevel2BusinessID,
		N1.ProductLevel2BusinessDescription,
		N1.ProductLevel3CategoryID,
		CASE 
			--WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription='US VMHS NBTY BROADLINE' THEN 'US VMHS NATURE’S BOUNTY' 
			WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription='US ORGAIN' THEN 'US-ORGAIN'
			ELSE N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription 
			END ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
		N1.ProductLevel4SubcategoryID,
		N1.ProductLevel4SubcategoryDescription,
		N1.ProductLevel5SegmentID,
		N1.ProductLevel5SegmentDescription,
		N1.Division,
		N1.Subdivision,
		N1.OPCO,
		N1.Company_Code,
		N1.Salesorg,
		N1.Distr_Chan,
		N1.CrossPlantMaterialStatus,
		N1.CorporateBrandCode,
		N1.CorporateBrandDescription,
		N1.RangeBrandCode,
		N1.RangeBrandDescription,
		N1.DenominationBrandCode,
		N1.DenominationBrandDescription,
		N1.AnimalFarm,
		(CASE WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription  like 'US%NUUN%' THEN 'US NUUN'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription ='US BOOST' THEN 'US BOOST'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription ='US BOOST KID ESSENTIALS' THEN 'US BOOST KID ESSENTIALS'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription ='US CBE' THEN 'US CBE'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription ='US CELLTRIENT' THEN 'US CELLTRIENT'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription like 'US%GUT HEALTH%' THEN 'US GUT HEALTH'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription='US ALLERGY' AND MaterialKey = 12411802 THEN 'US EHA'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription like 'US VMHS%' THEN 'US VMHS'
		ELSE 'Other'
		END) PL3NHSSales,
		1 as rn
	FROM [dr].[DimMaterialMaster] N1

)

INSERT INTO dr.dimCombinedMaterialHierarchy

SELECT 
		MaterialKey,
		MaterialID,
		MaterialDesc,
		EANUPC,
		MaterialType,
		ProductLevel1MarketID,
		ProductLevel1MarketDescription,
		ProductLevel2BusinessID,
		ProductLevel2BusinessDescription,
		ProductLevel3CategoryID,
		C.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
		ProductLevel4SubcategoryID,
		ProductLevel4SubcategoryDescription,
		ProductLevel5SegmentID,
		ProductLevel5SegmentDescription,
		Division,
		Subdivision,
		OPCO,
		Company_Code,
		Salesorg,
		Distr_Chan,
		CrossPlantMaterialStatus,
		CorporateBrandCode,
		CorporateBrandDescription,
		RangeBrandCode,
		RangeBrandDescription,
		DenominationBrandCode,
		DenominationBrandDescription,
		AnimalFarm,
		PL3NHSSales,
		NHS,
        NHS_Group

FROM Combined_Items C
LEFT JOIN [dr].[NHSC_Sales_Product_Groups] G ON G.[ProductLevel3CategoryDescription]=C.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription
WHERE rn=1

        ELSE 'Unknown'
END AS FullStateName,
C.ZipCode,
C.SubClassOfTrade AS Sub_Class_Of_Trade,

C.SAPCustomerId AS SAP_Customer_Id,

FROM [dbo].[FactEndSales] E
JOIN [dbo].[DimCustomer] C on C.CustomerId=E.ShipToCustomerId
JOIN [dbo].[DimCustomer] C2 on C2.CustomerId=E.SubmitByCustomerId
JOIN [dbo].[DimMaterial] M ON M.MaterialId=E.MaterialId
JOIN [dbo].[DimAgreement] A ON A.AgreementId=E.LinkedAgreementId
WHERE 

    C.AccountChannelId IN ('AC','HC','LT','NA')
AND CONVERT(DATE,CONCAT(LEFT(E.PeriodDateId,4),'-',SUBSTRING(convert(nvarchar,E.PeriodDateId),5,2),'-',RIGHT(E.PeriodDateId,2))) between '@{variables('YearLoad')}-01-01' AND '@{variables('YearLoad')}-12-31'

WITH
STARLENCOMP AS (SELECT 'Consumption' DataType,
                       'STARLEN' AREA,
                       rmrm#,
                       CHAR(NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD')) sDATE,
                       rmqty,
                       RMLHSE
                  FROM starlen.rmhstp
                 WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
                   AND rmdycd = 'D'
                   AND rmrmcd = 'PR'
                   AND rmfl11 = 'FRM100-8'),
SOFTGELSCOMP AS (SELECT 'Consumption' DataType,
                        'SOFTGELES' AREA,
                        rmrm#,
                        CHAR(NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD')) sDATE,
                        rmqty,
                        RMLHSE
                   FROM softgels.rmhstp
                  WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
                    AND rmdycd = 'D'
                    AND rmrmcd = 'PR'
                    AND rmfl11 = 'FRM100-8'),
SLMFGCOMP AS (SELECT 'Consumption' DataType,
                     'SLMFG' AREA,
                     rmrm#,
                     CHAR(NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD')) sDATE,
                     rmqty,
                     RMLHSE
                FROM slmfg.rmhstp
               WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
                 AND rmdycd = 'D'
                 AND rmrmcd = 'PR'
                 AND rmfl11 = 'FRM100-8'),
RSMFGCOMP AS (SELECT 'Consumption' DataType,
                     'RSMFG' AREA,
                     rmrm#,
                     CHAR(NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD')) sDATE,
                     rmqty,
                     RMLHSE
                FROM rsmfg.rmhstp
               WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
                 AND rmdycd = 'D'
                 AND rmrmcd = 'PR'
                 AND rmfl11 = 'FRM100-8'),
TXMFGCOMP AS (SELECT 'Consumption' DataType,
                     'TXMFG' AREA,
                     rmrm#,
                     CHAR(NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD')) sDATE,
                     rmqty,
                     RMLHSE
                FROM txmfg.rmhstp
               WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
                 AND rmdycd = 'D'
                 AND rmrmcd = 'PR'
                 AND rmfl11 = 'FRM100-8'),
ECMFGCOMP AS (SELECT 'Consumption' DataType,
                     'ECMFG' AREA,
                     rmrm#,
                     CHAR(NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD')) sDATE,
                     rmqty,
                     RMLHSE
                FROM ecmfg.rmhstp
               WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
                 AND rmdycd = 'D'
                 AND rmrmcd = 'PR'
                 AND rmfl11 = 'FRM100-8'),
STARLEN AS (SELECT 'PO_Receipt' DataType,
                   'STARLEN' AREA,
                   rmrm#,
                   NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD') sDATE,
                   rmqty,
                   RMLHSE
              FROM starlen.rmhstp
             WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
               AND rmdycd = 'A'
               AND (rmfl11 > 'UPDINV'
                AND rmfl11 < 'UPDINW')),
SOFTGELS AS (SELECT 'PO_Receipt' DataType,
                    'SOFTGELES' AREA,
                    rmrm#,
                    NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD') sDATE,
                    rmqty,
                    RMLHSE
               FROM softgels.rmhstp
              WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
                AND rmdycd = 'A'
                AND (rmfl11 > 'UPDINV'
                 AND rmfl11 < 'UPDINW')),
SLMFG AS (SELECT 'PO_Receipt' DataType,
                 'SLMFG' AREA,
                 rmrm#,
                 NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD') sDATE,
                 rmqty,
                 RMLHSE
            FROM slmfg.rmhstp
           WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
             AND rmdycd = 'A'
             AND (rmfl11 > 'UPDINV'
              AND rmfl11 < 'UPDINW')),
RSMFG AS (SELECT 'PO_Receipt' DataType,
                 'RSMFG' AREA,
                 rmrm#,
                 NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD') sDATE,
                 rmqty,
                 RMLHSE
            FROM rsmfg.rmhstp
           WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
             AND rmdycd = 'A'
             AND (rmfl11 > 'UPDINV'
              AND rmfl11 < 'UPDINW')),
TXMFG AS (SELECT 'PO_Receipt' DataType,
                 'TXMFG' AREA,
                 rmrm#,
                 NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD') sDATE,
                 rmqty,
                 RMLHSE
            FROM txmfg.rmhstp
           WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
             AND rmdycd = 'A'
             AND (rmfl11 > 'UPDINV'
              AND rmfl11 < 'UPDINW')),
ECMFG AS (SELECT 'PO_Receipt' DataType,
                 'ECMFG' AREA,
                 rmrm#,
                 NBTYGPL.idate(RMTRDT - 720000, '*YMD') sDATE,
                 rmqty,
                 RMLHSE
            FROM ecmfg.rmhstp
           WHERE rmtrdt > 950630
             AND rmdycd = 'A'
             AND (rmfl11 > 'UPDINV'
              AND rmfl11 < 'UPDINW')),
ALLDATA AS (SELECT *
              FROM STARLENCOMP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM SOFTGELSCOMP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM SLMFGCOMP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM RSMFGCOMP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM TXMFGCOMP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM ECMFGCOMP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM STARLEN
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM SOFTGELS
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM SLMFG
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM RSMFG
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM TXMFG
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM ECMFG)
SELECT DataType,
       AREA,
       rmrm# AS400_PartNumber,
       EBXITM OracleNumber,
       EBXNF2 Sap_MaterialNumber,
       sDATE,
       rmqty Qty,
       RMLHSE AS400_Warehouse,
       WHSF03 Sap_Plant,
       WHNAME Warehouse_Desc,
       ICC,
       WEEK(sDATE) WeekNumber,
       YEAR(sDATE) ||'-'|| MONTH(sDATE) YearMonth
       
  FROM ALLDATA a
  LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODFA.WHSMSTP w --pull Warehouse and Desc
               ON a.RMLHSE = w.WHSNBR  
  LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODFA.OEBSXRPF x --Oracle and Sap PartNumbers 
               ON x.EBXNBR = a.rmrm# 
              AND EBXTYP = 'RM'		--??? not sure on flag without many duplicate values.
 WHERE RMLHSE NOT IN (0, 8)

source.query:
WITH REST AS(
--NONULLS
SELECT
MCHB."MATNR",
REGEXP_REPLACE(MCHB."MATNR", '^0+', '') PRODUCT,
MCHB.WERKS as PLANT,
T006A.MSEH3 UOM, 
--MCHB.CLABS,
--MARM.UMREZ,
ROUND(COALESCE((MCHB.CLABS/MARM.UMREZ),MCHB.CLABS)) QTY

FROM "EDW"."PRS"."S6_ERPAMS_MCHB_V"  MCHB
JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MARC_V" MARC
ON MCHB.MATNR = MARC.MATNR
AND MCHB.WERKS = MARC.WERKS
JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_MARA_V as MARA
ON MARA.MATNR = MARC.MATNR
LEFT JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MARM_V" MARM
ON MCHB.MATNR = MARM.MATNR
AND MARC.AUSME = MARM.MEINH
LEFT JOIN  "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_T006A_V" T006A 
ON MARM.MEINH = T006A.MSEHI
AND SPRAS = 'E'
WHERE 1=1
AND MCHB.WERKS IN ('UM09','UM10' ,'UM13')
AND CLABS != 0 
--AND LEFT(PRODUCT,3) = 442),
--AND PRODUCT LIKE '%44305837'
--ORDER BY QTY
),
RESTFIX AS(
SELECT 
REST.MATNR,
PRODUCT,
PLANT,
MSEH3 UOM, 
QTY
FROM REST REST
JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_MARA_V as MARA
ON MARA.MATNR = REST.MATNR
LEFT JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MARM_V" MARM
ON MARA.MATNR = MARM.MATNR
AND MARA.MEINS = MARM.MEINH
LEFT JOIN  "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_T006A_V" T006A 
ON MARM.MEINH = T006A.MSEHI
AND SPRAS = 'E'
WHERE REST.UOM IS NULL
),

FIVE AS(
--ITEMS AS 105
SELECT DISTINCT 
MARD.MATNR,
REGEXP_REPLACE(mard."MATNR", '^0+', '') Product,
MARD.WERKS PLANT,
MSEH3 UOM,
LABST QTY
FROM   "EDW"."PRS"."S6_ERPAMS_MARD_V" MARD 
JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_MARA_V as MARA
ON MARA.MATNR = MARD.MATNR
LEFT JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MARM_V" MARM
ON MARA.MATNR = MARM.MATNR
AND MARA.MEINS = MARM.MEINH
LEFT JOIN  "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_T006A_V" T006A 
ON MARM.MEINH = T006A.MSEHI
AND SPRAS = 'E'

WHERE MARD.WERKS IN ('UM09','UM10' ,'UM13')
AND LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(mard."MATNR", '^0+', ''),3)=105
AND LABST != 0
),

SUBREST AS(
SELECT * FROM RESTFIX
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM REST WHERE UOM IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM FIVE
)



SELECT 
PRODUCT,
PLANT,
UOM,
ROUND(QTY) QTY
FROM SUBREST
ORDER BY PLANT,PRODUCT,QTY
